---
AI Factory 方案汇报
← 回到工作台
打印 / 导出 PDF

从一台机架讲清 AI Factory 的硬件主线：机架里有什么、一个请求怎么在里面跑、 代际之间到底变了什么、以及这些结论各自有多硬的证据。 内容包版本 0.2.0 · 数据截至 2026-08。

01
需求背景：为什么要有这么一张图

AI Factory 的方案沟通有一个反复出现的困难：硬件是立体的，而材料是平面的。 客户问「72 张卡怎么连成一台机器」「机房要准备多少电和水」「换下一代能多跑多少 token」， 这些问题的答案分散在参考架构文档、产品页脚注和分析师文章里，口径还各不相同。

本工具把这些资料收敛成一个可下钻的三维模型 + 一套可溯源的内容包： 集群 → 机架 → 托盘 → 板卡逐层展开，每个部件的每个数字都带出处与证据等级， 官方没公布的一律显示「未公布」而不是编一个看起来合理的数。目标不是做得漂亮， 而是讲的时候不会说错。

建立硬件主线认知：GPU / HBM / NVLink / NIC / DPU / 供电 / 液冷 各自解决什么问题。
用推理数据流动画解释各部件如何协同，把「参数量」翻译成「哪条链路会堵」。
代际对比只讲结构与已公布规格，产能只给区间且明确标注是粗估。
02
当前架构：GB300 NVL72 是一台什么机器

NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 · 48U（示意）
⚠️ U 位为示意占位：官方未公布逐 U 布局，图上只保证数量与不重叠。

一句话：它不是 18 台服务器摆在一个柜子里，而是 72 张 GPU 通过 NVLink 组成的单一计算单元。18 个计算托盘提供 72 张 B300 GPU 与 36 颗 Grace CPU， 9 个交换托盘里的 18 颗 NVSwitch ASIC 把它们连成无阻塞全互联——每张 GPU 恰好 18 条 NVLink，每颗 NVSwitch 分一条。

gpuCount 72张 官方规格
cpuCount 36颗 官方规格
computeTrayCount 18个 官方规格
nvswitchTrayCount 9个 官方规格
nvlinkAggregateBandwidthTBs 130TB/s 官方规格
gpuMemoryTotalTB 20TB 官方规格
gpuMemoryBandwidthTBs 576TB/s 官方规格
rackPowerKW 142kW 官方规格

售前口径提醒：GB300 的计算托盘是 2 Grace + 4 B300，网卡是 ConnectX-8、DPU 是 BlueField-3（不是上一代的 CX-7 / BF-2）； 交换托盘是 9 个、每个 2 颗 ASIC（不是 9 颗，也不是 18 个托盘）。 这几个数字说错，后面的结论客户就不会信了。

03
推理数据流：一个请求在机架里怎么跑

跟着一次推理请求走一遍 GB300 NVL72：它不是 18 台服务器堆在一个机柜里，而是把计算、互联、内存、工程系统共同设计出来的一台机柜级计算机——72 张 GPU 是一个逻辑计算域。以 DeepSeek-V3（MoE + MLA）为参考模型：权重与运行中的 KV Cache 都常驻在 GPU 的 HBM 里，prefill/decode 的张量并行同步与 MoE 层的 Token 分发/合并全部走机架内的 NVLink 全互联，不出机柜。

01
请求接入
网关鉴权与调度
逻辑层

客户端请求先经过 API 网关：鉴权、限流计量，调度器按模型与 SLA 选中承接的 GB300 机架与计算托盘。这一步是纯逻辑决策，不产生机架内的物理链路流量。

售前怎么解释：「能跑」的第一道门槛：多租户场景下，请求要先过安全边界和调度决策，才谈得上后面的算力细节。

02
请求接入
请求经业务网络进入计算托盘
物理层

请求经北向业务网络到达目标托盘的 BlueField-3 DPU——它是这台机柜级计算机对外的安全与流量入口，独立于主机运行，即使托盘内主机被攻破也不影响管理面。

售前怎么解释：DPU 体现的是超节点「工程」这一要素的价值：零信任边界让多租户共享同一台机柜级计算机成为可能——这也是这台机器「能跑」得安全的前提。

03
Prefill
Prefill：并行处理 Prompt
物理层

⚠️ 权重已经常驻在 72 张 B300 GPU 的 HBM 里，不会因为这次请求重新加载。Prefill 把 prompt 的全部 token 一次并行前向计算，各 GPU 上的张量并行部分和通过 NVLink 全互联（经 18 颗 NVSwitch ASIC）做 all-reduce 汇总——这是「机柜级计算机」而不是「18 台服务器」的直接体现。

售前怎么解释：「跑对」的起点：张量并行的 all-reduce 走的是机架内 1800 GB/s/卡的 NVLink，而不是慢得多的以太网出机架——判断超节点好坏的第 01 问就是「Scale-Up 域到底多大」。

04
KV 写入
写入 KV Cache
物理层

本轮 prompt 算完的 Key/Value 写进发起该请求的 GPU 自己的 HBM——这是本地显存写入，不经过机架内的任何一条网络链路。KV Cache 会随上下文长度和并发数线性增长，是 decode 阶段显存占用的主角。

售前怎么解释：很多人以为「加长上下文」只是加显存，其实还加了 decode 每一步要多读的字节数——这条账单直接决定后面「跑不跑得快」。冷 KV 数据也可以经 NVLink-C2C 溢出到 Grace 的 LPDDR5，构成「37 TB 快内存」的扩展池。

05
Decode
Decode：逐 Token 生成
物理层

每生成一个 token，都要重新读一遍常驻的激活权重，再叠加当前已累积的 KV Cache——这是带宽瓶颈而非算力瓶颈。张量并行部分和同样通过 NVLink 全互联同步。⚠️ 真实系统里 decode 会反复经过下面的 MoE 路由/分发/合并步骤，这里按单趟教学叙事呈现，不代表只发生一次。

售前怎么解释：「跑快」的关键不是峰值算力，而是显存带宽：decode 速度约等于「带宽 ÷ 每步要读的字节数」，这也是 Blackwell Ultra 相对上代主要加显存带宽而不是算力的原因。

06
MoE 分发
Router：为每个 Token 选择专家
逻辑层

DeepSeek-V3 每层配置 256 个路由专家 + 1 个共享专家，每个 Token 由路由器选出 8 个专家。这一步是纯计算决策，发生在 Token 所在的那张 GPU 上，不产生跨卡流量——真正的挑战在下一步的 Dispatch。

售前怎么解释：MoE 把算力做成了稀疏的，省了矩阵计算，但没有省掉判断——真正的系统压力在互联和调度，而不是这一步本身。

07
MoE 分发
Dispatch：All-to-All 分发 Token
物理层

路由结果确定后，Token 要被送到专家所在的 GPU 上执行——这是一轮 All-to-All：每张卡向不同目标发送不同数据，底层经 18 颗 NVSwitch ASIC 交叉互连的机架内全互联传输，而不是真的每两张卡之间各占一条物理线。

售前怎么解释：常见的三个坑，售前被问住基本都栽在这：①热点专家——少数专家被大量调用，承载它们的链路会拥堵；②尾时延——整层要等最慢的一批结果，单卡算力被闲置等待消耗；③小消息高频——decode 阶段消息粒度小，启动开销比带宽更要命。

08
MoE 合并
Combine：All-to-All 汇总结果
物理层

各专家算完的结果再经一轮 All-to-All 送回 Token 原本所在的 GPU，与其余层的输出汇合后进入下一层继续计算。MoE 节省了计算，却把系统压力转移到了互联与调度——这正是「买 GPU 之外还要看互联设计」的原因。

售前怎么解释：「跑稳」看的就是这一步：热点专家和尾时延不解决，峰值算力只是纸面数字，实际吞吐会被互联拖住。

09
结果返回
结果经 DPU 返回客户端
物理层

生成的 token 流式经 BlueField-3 DPU 与业务网络送回客户端——去程和回程走的是同一条北向链路。

售前怎么解释：「跑省」是最终的评价标准：不是有多少张卡，而是每瓦、每元能稳定产出多少 Token。Day 0 的 Demo 通常只证明「能跑」到「跑对」这一到两级，替代不了真正的商用验证。

10
结果返回
计费与日志
逻辑层

按输入/命中/输出三段计量，写入计费与可观测性系统。这一步同样是纯逻辑层动作，不占用机架内的物理网络平面。

售前怎么解释：判断一个超节点好不好，最终还是要连续追问那七个问题——不是只看卡数和峰值算力。

⚠️ 步骤的相对时长只用于动画节奏，不是真实时延；工具里也刻意 不把它换算成毫秒展示。真实时延请看下一节的 TTFT / TPOT 粗估区间。

04
代际变化：GB300 NVL72 → Vera Rubin NVL72 → Vera Rubin Ultra NVL576 → Groq 3 LPX → HGX B300
GB300 NVL72 → Vera Rubin NVL72
机架骨架没变：还是 18 个计算托盘 + 9 个交换托盘、每托盘 2 CPU + 4 GPU、每机架 72 张 GPU。想象中的「推倒重来」并没有发生。
真正翻倍的是三条带宽：单卡显存带宽 8 → 22 TB/s（官方称相对 Blackwell 2.8×）、NVLink 每卡 1.8 → 3.6 TB/s、每 GPU 出机架带宽 800 Gb/s → 1.6 Tb/s（网卡从 1 张变 2 张）。
密度变化集中在两处：交换托盘内的交换芯片 2 → 4 颗（每机架 18 → 36 颗），托盘正面网卡 4 → 8 张（每机架 72 → 144 张）。
显存容量**没有**变化：单卡都是 288 GB。「装得下多大模型」是同一量级，快的是吐 token 的速度。
⚠️ 口径纪律：Vera Rubin 的官方规格表明确标注「Preliminary information」，且**整机架功率至今未公布**——本工具因此拒绝给它算 tokens/W。
主要差异（按 roleKey 自动配对）：共 30 个部件配对，18 处有变化 （12 处无变化）

控制面管理节点 控制面管理节点 ×12 — ⚠️ 「未收录」不等于「没有」：GB300 的 12 台管理节点来自其企业参考架构文档，Vera Rubin 目前还没有对应的参考架构，因此本项目不建模——这一行是资料差异，不是产品差异。

NVLink 6 交换托盘 NVLink 第五代交换托盘 ×9 NVLink 第六代交换托盘 ×9 NVLink 第五代交换托盘 → NVLink 第六代交换托盘；asicsPerTray 2 个 → 4 个。

加速器（GPU） NVIDIA B300（Blackwell Ultra）GPU ×72 NVIDIA Rubin GPU ×72 288 GB HBM3e → 288 GB HBM4：容量不变、带宽 8 → 22 TB/s。稠密算力 FP4 15 → 35 PFLOPS/卡、FP8 5 → 17.5 PFLOPS/卡（两代都取带「dense」标注的官方值）。两代的单卡 TDP 官方都没公布，因此那一行是「无法比较」而不是「没变」。
HBM4 显存堆栈 HBM3e 高带宽显存堆栈 ×576 HBM4 高带宽显存堆栈 ×576 HBM3e 高带宽显存堆栈 → HBM4 高带宽显存堆栈；totalPerRackTB 20 TB → 20.7 TB；bandwidthPerRackTBs 576 TB/s → 1,580 TB/s。
ConnectX-9 SuperNIC 板 ConnectX-8 夹层网卡板（Mezzanine Board） ×36 ConnectX-9 SuperNIC 板（前置模块化仓） ×72 每机架数量 36 → 72；ConnectX-8 夹层网卡板（Mezzanine Board） → ConnectX-9 SuperNIC 板（前置模块化仓）；boardsPerTray 2 个 → 4 个。
Scale-out 网卡 NVIDIA ConnectX-8 SuperNIC ×72 NVIDIA ConnectX-9 SuperNIC ×144 ConnectX-8 → ConnectX-9，单口速率都是 800 Gb/s，变的是配比：GPU:NIC 从 1:1 变成 1:2，每 GPU 出机架带宽翻倍到 1.6 Tb/s，每机架网卡 72 → 144 张。
North/South DPU NVIDIA BlueField-3 B3240 DPU ×18 NVIDIA BlueField-4 DPU ×18 BlueField-3 → BlueField-4：官方给的对比是「2× 网络、6× 算力、3× 内存带宽」，聚合带宽约 480 Gb/s → 800 Gb/s。⚠️ 两条官方说法互相冲突：技术博客说 BF-4 内含 64 核 Grace，发布稿说它整合 Vera CPU——本项目原样记录不做取舍。
本地系统盘 M.2 NVMe 系统盘 ×18 — ⚠️ 「未收录」不等于「没有」：NVIDIA 尚未公布 Vera Rubin 计算托盘的本地 NVMe 配置，本项目因此不建模，不代表托盘上没有系统盘。
本地缓存盘 E1.S NVMe 本地缓存盘 ×72 — ⚠️ 同上，「未收录」不等于「没有」：官方未公布该层配置，本项目不猜。
NVLink 交换芯片 NVSwitch ASIC（第五代） ×18 NVLink 6 交换芯片 ×36 ★ 高风险数字：每托盘从 2 颗变 4 颗，托盘数不变（9 个），所以每机架 18 → 36 颗，scale-up 总带宽 130 → 260 TB/s。注意 GB300 那代「每卡 18 条 NVLink，每颗 NVSwitch 一条」的漂亮对应关系在 Vera Rubin 上**无法验证**——官方没公布每卡链路条数。
Vera Rubin NVL72 → Vera Rubin Ultra NVL576
★ 分水岭在于 **NVLink 域跨出了机架**，且这一点 NVIDIA 官方已经证实（2026-03 POD 博客）：8 个 MGX NVL 机架经「direct optical connections」组成单一 576-GPU NVLink 域。机架内仍然是铜背板——铜没有被取代，只是被限制在机架内。这是本代唯一同时有官方与分析师两个独立来源互相佐证的结构事实。
★ 规模阶梯与命名口径：NVIDIA 官方给出三档 Vera Rubin Ultra scale-up 域——NVL72、NVL144（新机型 Kyber，单机架）、旗舰 NVL576（本代，8 机架）。Kyber 与 NVL576 是**并列的两条产品线**，不是同一机架的两种叫法；2025-10 OCP 博客还留有编者按「本文已更新，将品牌从 Vera Rubin NVL144 改为 Vera Rubin NVL72」，记录了上一代命名口径的调整。同一篇 OCP 博客提到 Kyber「到 2027 年将容纳 576 张 Rubin Ultra GPU」——这是 2025 年时点的早期措辞，本项目**推断**它是 2026-03 拆分出 Kyber(NVL144)/NVL576 两条线之前的统称，具体对应关系官方未澄清。
机架内部具体怎么重排（9+18+9 分层、交换托架 9→18 个且高度压到 0.75U）、功率密度跳档（电源架 8×33kW→4×110kW、单卡 TDP 到 1.8–2.6 kW）——这些都只有 SemiAnalysis 一家分析师文章描述，NVIDIA 官方规格表还没出来，**不能当规格数字讲**，只能讲方向。
⚠️ capacityPolicy = analyst-modeled：即便拓扑骨架已官宣，机架内部规格仍主要来自第三方分析师，本工具对这一代**拒绝出任何产能数字**。
⚠️ 反常识留痕：分析师表格里 Rubin Ultra 的单封装显存是 192 GB HBM4，**比 Rubin 的 288 GB 还少**（且不是 HBM4e）。原样记录，不做「修正」。

★ 例外：Vera Rubin NVL72 ↔ Groq 3 LPX 不是「换代」，是「配对」

上面那串箭头读的是时间轴，唯独最后一格要换个读法。Groq 3 LPX 不接替 Vera Rubin NVL72，而是和它一起工作：NVIDIA 把推理的 decode 阶段拆成两半——Rubin GPU 负责 prefill 与 decode 的 attention（吃长上下文与 KV cache， 靠 HBM 的容量与带宽），LPU 负责 decode 的 FFN/MoE（吃小 batch 下的 确定性低时延，靠片上 SRAM）。官方称之为 attention–FFN 分离（AFD）， 由 NVIDIA Dynamo 做 KV-aware 路由：每生成一个 token，中间激活在两台机器之间来回一趟。

★ 先说最重要的一句：**这两台机器不是「谁取代谁」，是配对使用的**。NVIDIA 对 LPX 的每一条性能宣称都带着「paired with Vera Rubin」这个前提；本工具因此对 LPX 的 capacityPolicy 设为 paired-only，**拒绝给它出独立产能数字**。下面这张表读的是「分工」，不是「升级」。
分工的边界很清楚（官方技术博客原话）：**Rubin GPU 负责 prefill 与 decode 的 attention**（吃长上下文与 KV cache，靠 HBM 容量与带宽），**LPU 负责 decode 的 FFN/MoE**（吃小 batch 下的确定性低时延，靠片上 SRAM）。这个拆法官方叫 attention–FFN 分离（AFD），由 NVIDIA Dynamo 做 KV-aware 路由与编排：每生成一个 token，中间激活在两台机器之间来回一趟。
两种加速器的哲学正好相反：Rubin GPU 单卡 **288 GB HBM4 / 22 TB/s**；LP30 单颗 **500 MB SRAM / 150 TB/s**——容量差约 576 倍，带宽高约 6.8 倍。机架级同样如此：VR 20.7 TB HBM4 @ 1,580 TB/s vs LPX 128 GB SRAM @ 40 PB/s（约 25 倍带宽）。**容量换带宽**就是这笔交易的全部内容，所以 LPX 里的大模型必须按层切到许多颗 LPU 上（官方原话 layer-wise partitioning），不能按「单卡装得下多少」来算。
机架内互连也是两条路线：**Vera Rubin 是交换式**（9 个交换托盘 × 4 颗 NVLink 6 芯片 = 36 颗，260 TB/s）；**LPX 干脆没有交换层**——256 颗 LPU 之间是直连 C2C（每颗 96 条 112 Gb/s 链路），机架级 640 TB/s。少一跳换来的是更可控的时延与抖动，代价是拓扑固定、由编译器静态切分。
⚠️ 口径纪律三条：① 官方对 LPX **没有发过规格表**，所有数字都是产品页/技术博客的**厂商宣称**（证据徽章是 vendor_claim，不是 verified_spec）；② 机架 315 PFLOPS 与每托盘 9.6 PFLOPS 两条官方口径不完全闭合（32 × 9.6 = 307.2 ≠ 315），本项目两条并存、不互推；③ 「35× TPS/MW」是**配对系统**在 **400 TPS/用户** 交互度上对比 GB200 NVL72 的数字——前提拿掉就不成立，低交互度场景用同构 GPU 方案本来就够。
⚠️ 还有一条容易讲错的：NVIDIA 与 Groq 是**非排他技术许可 + 团队加入**（2025-12 Groq 官方新闻室），Groq 仍作为独立公司运营 GroqCloud。不要说成「NVIDIA 收购了 Groq」。
配对双方的部件对照（按 roleKey 自动配对）：共 30 个部件配对，19 处有变化 （11 处无变化）
部件 左 右 变化
Spine 交换层（计算网） Spectrum-X 以太网 / Quantum-X800 InfiniBand 交换层 ×1 — ⚠️ 同上：LPX 侧的 scale-out 主干官方未公布，本项目不猜。
Leaf 交换层（计算网） Spectrum-X 以太网 / Quantum-X800 InfiniBand 交换层 ×1 — ⚠️ 「未收录」不等于「没有」：LPX 没有官方参考架构，NVIDIA 未说明它的 scale-out 接入方案。本项目只建模了官方明确画出的部分（BlueField-4 的 North/South 通路，以及与 NVL72 之间的 AFD 交换）。
机架 第三代 MGX 液冷机架 ×8 NVIDIA MGX ETL 机架 ×8 左：第三代 MGX 单宽液冷机架（约 1.8 吨，45°C 液冷）。右：MGX ETL 机架，全液冷，容纳 32 个 1U 托盘。官方特别强调两者共用同一套 MGX 基础设施，让「token factory 只规划一种通用机架」——这是配对部署在机房侧最实在的好处。⚠️ LPX 的机架重量、U 高与进液温度官方都没公布。另注：官方产品页同一张卡片里 ETL / ELT 两种拼写都出现过，对外建议直接说「MGX 机架」。
供电层 Vera Rubin 机架供电层 ×8 LPX 机架供电层 ×8 ⚠️ 这一行两边**都是空的**：Vera Rubin 的电源架数量与整机架功率官方未公布，LPX 更彻底——官方给的能效口径全是相对值（35× TPS/MW、10× 收入/瓦），一个绝对功率数字都没有。因此「无变化」在这里的真实含义是「两边都无法比较」。客户做配电规划时，这两代都必须向 NVIDIA/OEM 单独确认。
计算托盘 Vera Rubin 计算托盘 ×18 — ⚠️ 「未收录」在这里的含义特殊：LPX **有**托盘，只是本项目给它单列了 `lpu-tray` 这个 roleKey（见下一行），没有和 NVLink 域三代的 `compute-tray` 配对。理由是两者不是同一类东西——VR 托盘 = 2 CPU + 4 GPU + 8 网卡 + 1 DPU；LPX 托盘 = 8 加速器 + 1 主机 CPU + 1 扩展逻辑 + 1 DPU，没有 scale-out 网卡。硬配对只会产出一条误导性的「18 → 32」。
NVLink 交换托盘 NVLink 第六代交换托盘 ×9 — ★ 这条「未收录」是**真的没有**，不是资料缺失：LPX 架构里不存在交换层，256 颗 LPU 之间是直连 C2C。这是本表最能说明「两条不同技术路线」的一行——左侧 9 个交换托盘是 NVLink 域成立的物理前提，右侧把这一层整个取消了。
机架内 scale-up 互连底板 NVLink PCB 中板（Midplane） ×1 LPU C2C Spine（机架内 scale-up 背板） ×1 ★ 三代演进在这一行看得最清楚：GB300 铜背板 → Vera Rubin PCB 中板（无线缆盲插，仍是交换式 NVLink）→ LPX 的 **LPU C2C Spine（无交换芯片，LPU 之间直连）**。左侧 260 TB/s 要经过 36 颗 NVLink 6 交换芯片；右侧 640 TB/s 一颗交换芯片都不经过。⚠️ 官方只说了 LPX「无线缆」「经背板/spine 连接」，**没有公布 spine 的物理介质**（铜还是光），3D 里的形态是示意。
LPX 托盘冷板 冷板（Cold Plate） ×18 冷板（Cold Plate） ×32 每机架数量 18 → 32。
主机 CPU NVIDIA Vera CPU ×36 LPX 托盘主机 CPU（型号未公布） ×32 左：NVIDIA Vera，88 核自研 Olympus，每托盘 2 颗、每机架 36 颗，经 NVLink-C2C 与 GPU 共享内存空间——是这台机器的一等公民。右：**型号官方未公布**，每托盘 1 颗，官方托盘图里只标了「Host CPU」四个字，挂最高 128 GB DRAM。⚠️ 这一行绝大多数规格会落进「无法比较」而不是「变化」——因为右侧根本没有数字。★ 特别提醒：LPX 托盘上的 BlueField-4 **自带 CPU**，但它和这颗主机 CPU 在官方图里是两个并列的盒子，不能拿 BF-4 里那颗去填这一行的空。
加速器（GPU ↔ LPU） NVIDIA Rubin GPU ×72 NVIDIA Groq 3 LPU（LP30） ×256 ★ 这一行是整张表的核心，但它**不是一次升级**——是两种加速器哲学的对照。左：Rubin GPU，每托盘 4 张、每机架 72 张，288 GB HBM4 / 22 TB/s，跑 prefill 与 decode-attention。右：Groq 3 LP30，每托盘 8 颗、每机架 256 颗，**500 MB 片上 SRAM**（不是 GB，也没有 HBM）/ 150 TB/s / 2.5 TB/s C2C，跑 decode 的 FFN/MoE。⚠️ 自动 diff 会把它标成「数量变化 72 → 256」，那个数字**没有可比性**：一颗 LPU 不等于一张 GPU，别拿它讲「密度提升 3.5 倍」。另外 LPU 走内容模型里的 `kind: "lpu"` 分支，类型层面就不带 GPU 的 roofline 数学参数，产能估算不会误把它当 GPU 用。
HBM 显存堆栈 HBM4 高带宽显存堆栈 ×576 — ★ 又一条「真的没有」：LP30 不带 HBM，工作集全在 500 MB 片上 SRAM 里，机架级 DRAM（12 TB DDR5）挂在托盘的 fabric expansion logic 与主机 CPU 上，属于第二层容量而不是 decode 主路径。客户问「LPX 能装多大模型」时，答案不能按显存算，要按「切到多少颗 LPU 上」算。
网卡夹层板 ConnectX-9 SuperNIC 板（前置模块化仓） ×72 — ⚠️ 「未收录」不等于「没有」：LPX 托盘的前面板连接形态官方未细化到板级，本项目不建模。
Scale-out 网卡 NVIDIA ConnectX-9 SuperNIC ×144 — ⚠️ 「未收录」不等于「没有」：NVIDIA 的 LPX 托盘图里只画了 BlueField-4 与「backplane and front-panel connections」，没有出现 ConnectX 系列，官方正文也没提 scale-out 网卡。本项目因此不建模——这是资料缺口，不是产品结论。
North/South DPU NVIDIA BlueField-4 DPU ×18 NVIDIA BlueField-4 DPU ×32 唯一一个两边**完全相同**的关键部件：都是 NVIDIA BlueField-4，每托盘 1 张（本内容包直接复用同一个组件定义，因此判为无变化）。数量上左 18 张、右 32 张，只是因为托盘数不同。它也是 LPX 与外界（存储、业务网）唯一的官方通路——官方托盘图里没有出现任何 ConnectX 系列网卡。
NVLink 交换芯片 NVLink 6 交换芯片 ×36 — ★ 同上，这也是**真的没有**：LPX 架构里不存在交换芯片这个部件。左侧每机架 36 颗，右侧 0 颗——不是没建模，是架构里就没有。
交换托盘冷板 冷板（Cold Plate） ×9 — ★ 随交换托盘一起消失：LPX 没有交换托盘，自然也没有它的冷板。托盘冷板本身两边都有（cold-plate 行）。
AFD 对端机架（示意） — 配对的 Vera Rubin NVL72 机架（AFD 对端，示意） ×1 ★ 右侧独有，而且它指的**就是左侧这台机器**：LPX 场景里画出配对的 Vera Rubin NVL72，是为了提醒「LPX 从来不是单独部署的」。这个节点没有自己的规格，真正的建模在 sys.vera-rubin-nvl72 代际里。
LPX 计算托盘（1U） — Groq 3 LPX 计算托盘（1U 液冷） ×32 ★ 右侧独有：32 个 1U 液冷无线缆托盘，每个 8 颗 LP30 + 1 颗主机 CPU + 1 个 fabric expansion logic + 1 张 BlueField-4，单托盘 4 GB SRAM / 1.2 PB/s / FP8 9.6 PFLOPS / 20 TB/s scale-up。1U 塞得下 8 颗加速器，是因为既没有 HBM 也没有 800 W 级的芯片。对照左侧的 18 个计算托盘 + 9 个交换托盘。
Fabric Expansion Logic — Fabric Expansion Logic（托盘内扩展逻辑） ×32 ★ 右侧独有：托盘上的扩展逻辑，一边把 8 颗 LP30 的 C2C 链路引到背板与前面板（跨托盘、跨机架），一边挂最高 256 GB DRAM。它是 LPX「无线缆机架」能成立的关键件，作用位置约等于 Vera Rubin 那边的 PCB 中板接口层。⚠️ 官方只给了功能描述，没有公布它是 ASIC、FPGA 还是交换芯片。

其余 3 条前提与限制
为什么 NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX 这一格是空的（reasonCode：paired-only-policy）

这不是「差一个官方数字」——注意它的「缺少的官方数据」列表是空的 （0 项）。LPX 的产能语义本身就只在配对场景下成立： NVIDIA 对它的每一条性能宣称都带着「paired with Vera Rubin」这个前提， 官方从未给出「LPX 单独跑能出多少 token」的口径。本工具因此把它的 capacityPolicy 设为paired-only，在查找 GPU 组件之前就拒绝出数。

NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX 只在与配对系统联合工作时才有产能语义（如与 GPU 机架组成 AFD 配对），本工具不提供它的独立产能数字。

⚠️ 推论：任何来源给你一个「Groq 3 LPX 每机架 N tokens/s」的独立数字，都要先问它的口径出处。 官方能对得上的只有相对指标——与 Vera Rubin NVL72 配对后，在 400 TPS/用户 的交互度上， 每兆瓦吞吐最高 35×（对比 GB200 NVL72）。

⚠️ 内部材料转述，非官方口径，不构成规格
素材来源：《超节点 — WAIC 2026 内部材料》 · 内部 · 2026-07（详见上一节「全部数据源」）

客户经常在对比完 NVIDIA 方案之后，顺口问一句「国产的超节点现在做到什么程度了」。 这一节不回答具体规格——素材来自一份 2026 WAIC 内部资料的转述，没有可访问的官方规格表佐证， 因此这里只给规模阶梯与结构差异两条粗线，帮你先接住这个问题， 不给客户任何具体数字，也不把它和上面几节的可溯源 Claim 体系混在一起。

规模阶梯对照
阶梯 行业口径（WAIC 2026 转述） 本工具同尺对照
单柜 32–128 卡 NVL72 = 72 卡（GB300 / Vera Rubin，单柜）
Scale-Up 域 256–1,024 卡 NVL576 = 576 卡（Rubin Ultra，8 柜跨柜域）；LPX = 256 卡（单柜，恰好落在这一档下限）
集群 万卡+ 本工具目前四代都停在 Scale-Up 域内，未建模到这一档
厂商四分类
平台型：华为、阿里、百度昆仑芯——从芯片到超节点整机架构自己包圆。
AI 芯片：摩尔线程、沐曦、燧原、壁仞等——独立芯片厂商，超节点整机通常 与其他厂商合作交付。
OEM-ICT：中兴、新华三、联想、中科曙光、浪潮、超聚变——把芯片厂商的 加速卡集成进整机/整柜方案。
推理基础设施：阡视科技（wylon Q72/288）——单独成一类，专攻推理场景的 超节点产品线。

名单转引自内部材料里标注「OpenAI 整理」的一页行业梳理，不是本工具的独立调研， 分类边界与名单本身都会随时间变化。

与本工具 NVL72 / NVL576 的三点结构差异（定性，不给数字）
柜间互连媒介：本工具建模的 NVL72/NVL576 柜内走铜背板，只有跨柜层级 （如 NVL576 的 8 柜互联）才上光；deck 里的国产方案更早、更普遍地把跨柜光互连当作 Scale-Up 域本身的主要媒介——域的物理边界不再等于「一个柜子」。
背板设计：本工具两代都走「NVLink 背板」——插卡先汇聚到背板，再由背板 连交换层；deck 里描述的部分国产方案是「正交无背板」，卡间直接正交对插，省掉背板这一层。
交换芯片与协议：本工具的 NVSwitch 是 NVIDIA 自研、协议不对外公开； deck 里国产厂商同样各自自研交换 ASIC 与协议（灵衢、ALink、凌云等命名都出现过）， 但对外公开程度不一——这正是判断超节点第②问要追问的地方（见学习手册）。

以上三点均来自 deck 照片与二手叙述的定性转述，没有官方规格佐证，因此只写结构性差异， 不给任何链路数、带宽或时延数字。

拿到华为 Atlas 950 / 阿里磐久 AL128 官方规格（可访问 URL）后，本节可以升级为完整的 3D 建模包。

```text
- Precise coordination between memory and compute.
- Explicit control over instruction timing.
- Reduced execution jitter under variable workloads

For real-time inference, this determinism helps keep time-to-first-token and per-token latency stable, even at small batch sizes.

## The shift toward interactive inference [Scroll to The shift toward interactive inference section](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/inside-nvidia-groq-3-lpx-the-low-latency-inference-accelerator-for-the-nvidia-vera-rubin-platform/\#the_shift_toward_interactive_inference)

AI inference spans a broad performance spectrum. On one end are throughput-optimized services such as batch document processing, moderation, embeddings, and media pipelines, where the goal is to maximize tokens per GPU, tokens per watt, or overall cost efficiency. These workloads often support large-scale shared services, including free-tier and background AI offerings, where high utilization matters more than per-user responsiveness.

On the other end are latency-optimized services such as coding assistants, chatbots, voice assistants, copilots, and interactive agents, where delays are immediately visible to users. In these workloads, the most important metrics are time-to-first-token, tokens per second per user, and tail latency. Many modern AI platforms must support both regimes simultaneously, running high-throughput backends for large-scale processing while delivering responsive interactive experiences. This divergence is one reason heterogeneous inference architectures are becoming increasingly important.

### What makes interactive inference harder [Scroll to What makes interactive inference harder section](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/inside-nvidia-groq-3-lpx-the-low-latency-inference-accelerator-for-the-nvidia-vera-rubin-platform/\#what_makes_interactive_inference_harder)

Several trends are making low-latency interactive inference both more important and harder to serve efficiently, as shown in Table 3. As models produce longer outputs and context windows grow, more of the workload shifts into decode, where tokens are generated sequentially, and responsiveness is exposed directly to the user.

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **Force** | **Why it matters** |
| **Low-latency as a product feature** | In interactive applications, responsiveness is no longer just an infrastructure metric; it is part of what users evaluate. |
| **Longer reasoning outputs** | As models generate longer outputs and multi-step chains of thought, more of the request shifts into sequential token generation. |
| **Prefix caching** | Reusing shared prompt state can reduce prefill cost, but it also increases the relative share of request-specific decode work that still has to be served quickly. |
| **Longer contexts** | As context grows, the Transformer’s self-attention mechanism becomes increasingly constrained by data movement and memory bandwidth. |

_Table 3. Four forces that make traditional serving techniques less effective for low-latency inference_

At the same time, longer contexts increase pressure on memory bandwidth and data movement, while serving many concurrent users reduces the batching efficiency that throughput-oriented systems rely on. As a result, systems optimized for maximum aggregate throughput are not always the best fit for workloads that require fast, predictable token generation for each request.

This challenge becomes even more pronounced in agentic AI, where systems repeatedly cycle through inference, retrieval, tool use, and reasoning. In these loops, latency compounds across each step, making stable per-token performance and strong tail-latency behavior critical for responsive user experiences.

### The era of agentic inference requires a new architecture [Scroll to The era of agentic inference requires a new architecture section](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/inside-nvidia-groq-3-lpx-the-low-latency-inference-accelerator-for-the-nvidia-vera-rubin-platform/\#the_era_of_agentic_inference_requires_a_new_architecture)

Inference isn’t a single, uniform workload. Within a request, prefill and decode place different demands on hardware, and those demands shift with batch size, context length, and model structure. Some phases, including self-attention and sparse MoE, can become highly sensitive to memory bandwidth and data movement, while others, such as dense projection and feed-forward layers, scale efficiently on throughput-optimized hardware when enough parallelism is available. In interactive decode, many operations run at very small batch sizes, making latency much more sensitive to stalls, contention, and jitter.

Optimizing the entire pipeline for only one regime forces a compromise. Hardware tuned for peak throughput under large batches isn’t ideal for the most latency-sensitive execution paths, while hardware optimized for low-latency execution is less efficient for the most compute-intensive phases.

As shown in Figure 4, a heterogeneous system combines both approaches, pairing low-latency interactive performance with high AI factory throughput. The result is a two-engine architecture: GPUs deliver high output for context-heavy prefill and execute decode attention, while LPUs accelerate latency-sensitive decode components such as FFN/MoE execution. Together, they improve interactivity without giving up AI factory throughput.

![A conceptual chart showing how throughput-optimized hardware, low-latency hardware, and a heterogeneous combination each occupy different parts of the tradeoff between AI factory throughput and interactive responsiveness.](https://developer-blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Heterogenous-AI.gif)_Figure 4. Heterogeneous inference expands the Pareto frontier_

## Vera Rubin NVL72 meets LPX [Scroll to Vera Rubin NVL72 meets LPX section](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/inside-nvidia-groq-3-lpx-the-low-latency-inference-accelerator-for-the-nvidia-vera-rubin-platform/\#vera_rubin_nvl72_meets_lpx)

Modern inference is a relay race. The same hardware that runs the heavy context leg doesn’t need to anchor the sprint to the next token. Rubin GPUs are the flexible, general-purpose workhorses for training and inference. They deliver high throughput across many model sizes, batch regimes, and serving patterns, from long-context prefill to decode attention and high-concurrency inference at scale.

LPX adds a specialized path optimized for fast, latency-sensitive token generation. Together, they enable a heterogeneous inference design that improves interactive responsiveness without giving up system-scale efficiency.

![Diagram comparing NVIDIA Rubin GPU and Groq 3 LPU, highlighting Rubin’s high FLOPS and large HBM memory versus Groq 3 LPU’s high-bandwidth on-chip SRAM for low-latency inference.](https://developer-blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/LPX05-Rubin_GPU_and_Groq_3_LPU.webp)_Figure 5. Uniting processors of extreme FLOPS (Rubin GPU) and bandwidth (Groq 3 LPU)_

### Decode phase: A repeated multi-engine loop [Scroll to Decode phase: A repeated multi-engine loop section](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/inside-nvidia-groq-3-lpx-the-low-latency-inference-accelerator-for-the-nvidia-vera-rubin-platform/\#decode_phase_a_repeated_multi-engine_loop)

The prefill phase is dominated by ingesting large inputs and building the KV cache—a workload that benefits from dense parallel compute and large memory capacity. The Vera Rubin NVL72 handles this phase efficiently, especially for long-context workloads and MoE models where context can be large and highly variable.

The decode phase is different. Decode is a repeated per-token loop, and different parts of that loop stress different bottlenecks. In the Vera Rubin platform architecture with LPX, decode is best thought of as a two-engine loop. GPUs handle decode work that benefits most from throughput and large memory capacity, such as full-context attention over the accumulated KV cache. LPX accelerates latency-sensitive execution within decode, such as sparse MoE expert feed-forward networks (FFNs) and other pointwise operations. This split, often described as decode phase disaggregation or attention–FFN disaggregation (AFD), separates attention from FFN within decode and exchanges intermediate activations for each token, so each engine runs the part of the loop it is best suited to execute. This AFD loop expands the highest-value operating region of the Pareto frontier.

![Diagram showing decode as a two-engine loop where Rubin GPUs handle attention over the KV cache while LPUs execute feed-forward or MoE layers, exchanging intermediate activations (interim tensor state) each token to improve latency and throughput.](https://developer-blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Decode-Loop.webp)_Figure 6. AFD decode explained_

At rack scale and beyond, the LPX is designed to operate as a tightly coordinated unit of compute, minimizing coordination overhead and reducing jitter. This is valuable in decode-heavy, agentic workflows where small delays compound across many model calls and verification loops.

### NVIDIA Dynamo makes heterogeneous decode operational [Scroll to NVIDIA Dynamo makes heterogeneous decode operational section](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/inside-nvidia-groq-3-lpx-the-low-latency-inference-accelerator-for-the-nvidia-vera-rubin-platform/\#nvidia_dynamo_makes_heterogeneous_decode_operational)

Making heterogeneous decode practical requires software that can classify requests, route work by latency targets, move intermediate activations with low overhead, and keep tail latency stable under bursty, variable traffic. [NVIDIA Dynamo](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/nvidia-dynamo-1-production-ready/) provides that orchestration layer by coordinating disaggregated serving and disaggregated decode across heterogeneous backends.

In practice, Dynamo routes prefill to GPU workers to process the large context and build the KV cache. During decode, Dynamo orchestrates the AFD loop where GPUs run attention over the accumulated KV cache, intermediate activations are handed off to LPUs for FFN/MoE execution, and outputs return to the GPUs to continue token generation. The result is a single coherent serving path with more predictable tail latency while sustaining high AI factory throughput.

![Diagram showing NVIDIA Dynamo coordinating heterogeneous inference across two racks. Large context is processed on VR NVL72 GPUs for prefill and KV cache creation. During decode, GPUs run attention over the KV cache while LPX runs FFN/MoE execution, with interim decode activations exchanged between GPU and LPX in a repeated loop to generate tokens.](https://developer-blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/LPX07-NVIDIA_Dynamo_Orchestrates_Disagg_Compute.webp)_Figure 7. Dynamo orchestrates heterogeneous compute_

With KV-aware routing, low-overhead transfers, and latency-target-driven scheduling, Dynamo helps keep interactive sessions out of long queues, reduces cross-tenant jitter, and maintains stable tail latency as concurrency and request shapes vary. The result is a production-ready heterogeneous serving model that delivers responsive user experiences while sustaining high AI factory throughput at scale.

### ​​Accelerating speculative decoding with LPX [Scroll to ​​Accelerating speculative decoding with LPX section](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/inside-nvidia-groq-3-lpx-the-low-latency-inference-accelerator-for-the-nvidia-vera-rubin-platform/\#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8Baccelerating_speculative_decoding_with_lpx)

[Speculative decoding](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/an-introduction-to-speculative-decoding-for-reducing-latency-in-ai-inference/) is an increasingly important technique for reducing latency in LLM inference. The approach uses a smaller draft model to generate multiple candidate tokens ahead of time, while a larger target model verifies and accepts those tokens in parallel. When the predictions match, multiple tokens can be committed at once, significantly increasing effective tokens per second and reducing response latency.

LPX is well-suited to act as the draft-generation engine in this architecture. The deterministic execution model and extremely high on-chip SRAM bandwidth of the LPU enable very fast draft token generation, enabling the draft model to run ahead of the verifier. At the same time, GPUs such as Rubin remain highly efficient for large-model execution tasks such as prefill, attention processing, and token verification.

By pairing the two, the system combines the strengths of both processors:

- LPX generates draft tokens rapidly using its low-latency architecture.
- Rubin GPUs verify and finalize tokens efficiently using high-throughput compute and large memory capacity.

This separation enables speculative decoding to run across heterogeneous processors, rather than running both draft and verifier models on the same hardware. The result is a system that can deliver faster draft generation without sacrificing the efficiency of GPU-based verification.

![Diagram showing speculative decoding where a GPU target model verifies tokens generated by a draft model running on LPX, allowing multiple tokens to be accepted per step and reducing inference latency.](https://developer-blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Speculative-Decoding.gif)_Figure 8. Speculative decoding with GPU verification and LPU draft generation_

## Unlocking intelligent agentic swarms [Scroll to Unlocking intelligent agentic swarms section](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/inside-nvidia-groq-3-lpx-the-low-latency-inference-accelerator-for-the-nvidia-vera-rubin-platform/\#unlocking_intelligent_agentic_swarms)

As AI use cases evolve from simple chat and batch inference to multi-step agentic workflows, responsiveness becomes a requirement. Offline inference and basic assistants can often prioritize aggregate throughput, but interactive applications, deep research, and agentic pipelines combine high token volume with tight feedback loops, where latency compounds across many model calls and tool interactions.

In this regime, heterogeneous inference matters. Pairing a high-throughput engine for long-context processing with a low-latency engine for decode FFNs makes it possible to increase user interactivity without sacrificing AI factory output.

![ Chart showing compute requirements increasing with interactivity as AI evolves from offline inference and simple chatbots to reasoning workflows, coding assistants, and autonomous multi-agent systems.](https://developer-blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Agentic-Scaling.webp)_Figure 9. Relative compute and interactivity requirements for various AI workloads, highlighting the need for high throughput and low-latency for agentic swarms_

### Unlocking a new category of AI experiences on the Pareto frontier [Scroll to Unlocking a new category of AI experiences on the Pareto frontier section](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/inside-nvidia-groq-3-lpx-the-low-latency-inference-accelerator-for-the-nvidia-vera-rubin-platform/\#unlocking_a_new_category_of_ai_experiences_on_the_pareto_frontier)

A practical way to visualize this tradeoff between performance and cost is the [Pareto frontier](https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/revenue-potential-ai-factories/), plotting user interactivity, measured in tokens per second per user (TPS per user), on the horizontal axis against AI factory throughput, measured in tokens per second per megawatt (TPS per MW), on the vertical axis.

## What NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX enables for Developers [Scroll to What NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX enables for Developers section](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/inside-nvidia-groq-3-lpx-the-low-latency-inference-accelerator-for-the-nvidia-vera-rubin-platform/\#what_nvidia_groq_3_lpx_enables_for_developers)

Developers are increasingly building systems that require three things at once:

- **Responsiveness:** low and predictable latency for interactive experiences and agent loops.
- **Capability:** strong model quality, reasoning depth, and long-context understanding.
- **Scale:** high-throughput and cost efficiency to serve many concurrent users or agents.

LPX broadens the set of workloads an AI factory can serve efficiently. Use the low-latency path where predictable token generation improves experience, such as coding assistants, agentic workflows with tight tool-calling loops, voice interactions, and real-time translation. Keep throughput-first workloads on Rubin GPUs, such as batch serving, long-context throughput runs, where high concurrency and batching keep GPUs consistently busy and cost-efficient. The operational shift is mindset. Stop optimizing for one headline metric and start optimizing for a range of real-world operating points.

## Learn more [Scroll to Learn more section](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/inside-nvidia-groq-3-lpx-the-low-latency-inference-accelerator-for-the-nvidia-vera-rubin-platform/\#learn_more)

Dive deeper into the architecture behind NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX and Vera Rubin by starting with the NVIDIA product pages and technical blogs covering the [Vera Rubin platform](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/inside-the-nvidia-rubin-platform-six-new-chips-one-ai-supercomputer/), [LPX](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/lpx/), [AFD](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/on-demand/session/other25-dynamoday09/), and [Dynamo](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/nvidia-dynamo-1-production-ready/). Explore the underlying research on tensor streaming processors and software-defined silicon design for AI. Together, these resources offer a deeper look at the hardware, system architecture, and orchestration software behind heterogeneous, low-latency inference at scale. Next, join a [NVIDIA Developer Forum](https://forums.developer.nvidia.com/) thread focused on inference and deployment to compare notes with other teams building low-latency serving systems.

# NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX Now in Full Production With World-Class Speed for Agentic AI

Groq 3 LPX Extends the Vera Rubin Platform, Delivering Ultrafast Token Generation for the Next Generation of Agentic AI, With Nebius the First to Adopt

August 24, 2026


[![NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX Now in Full Production With World-Class Speed for Agentic AI](https://iprsoftwaremedia.com/219/files/202608/d61fba36e887bdc54b45bd9d3bb74a2e/6a8b9f313d6332894389b07d_nvidia-groq-3-lpx-rack/nvidia-groq-3-lpx-rack_mid.png?v=371bafaf-61ba-429f-b95b-fc5eb12cfff9)](https://iprsoftwaremedia.com/219/files/202608/d61fba36e887bdc54b45bd9d3bb74a2e/nvidia-groq-3-lpx-rack.png)

**News Summary:**

- In Artificial Analysis benchmarking, Groq 3 LPX showcased world-class speed for agentic coding and other latency-sensitive workloads.
- NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX extends the inference performance of NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems by dramatically increasing token generation rates.
- Nebius is the first AI cloud to adopt NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX.

**Hot Chips—** NVIDIA today announced that [NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/lpx/ "NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX"), the interactive AI inference accelerator, is now in full production. An extension of the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform, Groq 3 LPX delivers a major boost in AI inference by enabling ultrafast token generation for highly responsive agentic systems.

Agentic systems can generate massive volumes of tokens across hundreds or thousands of inference steps, making faster token generation critical for agents to reason, act and complete complex tasks in real time.

Vera Rubin NVL72 systems provide the most versatile training and inference platform for every AI factory. NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX extends the inference performance of Vera Rubin NVL72 by dramatically increasing the rate of token generation, providing premium user experiences for context-heavy workloads so agents can act at extreme speeds.

NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX is pushing the frontier of AI inference. It delivered a record 3,400 output tokens per second in Artificial Analysis benchmarking running Gemma 4 31B, an open source agentic model, with a 100,000-token context critical for agentic systems — the fastest performance ever recorded for the model.

Groq 3 LPX enables agentic tasks such as coding in minutes versus hours, providing 4x faster responsiveness for agents and latency-sensitive workloads than the nearest alternative platform.

“Inference is the growth engine of AI. NVIDIA Grace Blackwell and NVL72 revolutionized large language model inference with an unprecedented leap in performance and efficiency,” said Jensen Huang, founder and CEO of NVIDIA. “Vera Rubin extends that vision with workload-optimized AI factory configurations designed for the era of agentic AI, advancing the performance frontier with LPX for ultrafast token generation. This transforms how intelligence is produced, delivering another giant leap in AI throughput, efficiency and responsiveness, just as demand for AI computation is accelerating worldwide.”

**Groq 3 LPX — The Interactive AI Inference Accelerator**

Agentic AI creates two distinct computing challenges: efficiently processing enormous amounts of context and generating tokens with extremely low latency.

NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX is purpose-built to extend Vera Rubin’s interactivity — the rate at which tokens are generated for an individual user, determining how quickly an agent can complete each step of its work.

Faster generation gives agents more time to inspect files, write and test code, call tools, verify results and iterate while maintaining a responsive user experience.

**AI Cloud Momentum for Groq 3 LPX**

AI clouds are becoming the engines of the AI economy, giving enterprises and developers access to advanced infrastructure for training, reasoning and inference at scale. For providers serving latency-sensitive, high-volume inference workloads, NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX provides a path to deploy differentiated compute in proven rack-scale systems.

[Nebius](https://nebius.com/blog/posts/nvidia-groq-3-lpx-nebius-token-factory ""), a leading AI cloud, plans to bring NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX to [Nebius Token Factory](https://nebius.com/services/token-factory ""), its production inference platform, giving developers access to extreme token generation speed for highly responsive agentic AI applications.

“Generation is the phase of inference that determines how responsive an AI system actually is, and that’s exactly what NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX is built to accelerate,” said Danila Shtan, chief technology officer of Nebius. “As the first AI cloud bringing it to production via Nebius Token Factory, we’re making sure every step of an agent’s loop feels instant — through the same API developers are already using, with no migration to a new stack.”

Following Nebius, purpose-built AI inference cloud [Groq](https://groq.com/blog/groq-among-the-first-to-bring-nvidia-groq-3-lpx-and-vera-rubin-nvl72-to-market "") plans to be among the platform’s earliest adopters.

**Extreme Codesign for AI Factories**

Through extreme codesign across seven chips and five purpose-built racks, NVIDIA Vera Rubin is the most extensive AI factory platform.

NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 and Groq 3 LPX tackle the various workload requirements of customer AI factories, including frontier model makers and open model service providers.

These rack platforms feature NVIDIA BlueField®-4 DPUs and work in combination with NVIDIA Vera CPU racks, NVIDIA Vera BlueField-4 STX storage and NVIDIA Spectrum™-6 SPX Ethernet to optimize multi-agent systems for the highest throughput per watt and the lowest-latency inference.

**About NVIDIA**

[NVIDIA](https://www.nvidia.com/ "") (NASDAQ: NVDA) is the world leader in AI and accelerated computing.

144	As independent third-party [SemiAnalysis InferenceMax benchmarks](https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/data-blackwell-ultra-performance-lower-cost-agentic-ai/) demonstrate, NVIDIA rack-scale systems deliver 50x better performance per watt and 35x lower cost per token (NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 versus NVIDIA H200), which translates directly into higher revenues and better operating margins.
145	
146	In 2024, NVIDIA shipped the first NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 rack-scale systems. In 2025, NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 was shipped. Now, NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 is in full production, on track to ship in the second half of 2026.
147	
148	### Streamlined design of NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 [Scroll to Streamlined design of NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 section](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/nvidia-vera-rubin-pod-seven-chips-five-rack-scale-systems-one-ai-supercomputer/\#streamlined_design_of_nvidia_vera_rubin_nvl72)
149	
150	[NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/vera-rubin-nvl72/) is an engineering marvel designed to drop seamlessly into existing data center footprints. It will feature nearly two times more transistors than [NVIDIA GB200 NVL72](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/gb200-nvl72/) while delivering 10x more performance per watt through extreme co-design. The rack integrates 72 NVIDIA Rubin GPUs, 36 NVIDIA Vera CPUs, ConnectX-9 SuperNICs, and BlueField-4 DPUs across 18 compute trays, alongside 9 NVLink switch trays. In total, the rack houses 1.3 million individual components, nearly 1,300 chips, all packed into a single-wide third-generation NVIDIA MGX rack weighing roughly 4,000 lbs, or about the weight of a pickup truck.
151	
152	![Image showing the full Vera Rubin NVL72 rack with 18 compute trays and 9 NVLink switch trays.](https://developer-blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/nvidia-vera-rubin-nvl72-rack-1.webp)_Figure 6. NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 rack_
153	
154	#### Compute and NVLink Switch trays
155	
156	Enabling these 72 GPUs to act as a single unified engine is the sixth-generation NVLink. It delivers 3.6 TB/s of bandwidth per GPU and 260 TB/s of scale-up bandwidth per rack—more data than the bandwidth of the entire global internet. This high-speed data transfer happens in the NVLink spine at the back of the rack, which features four modular preintegrated cable cartridges housing 5,000 copper cables over two miles in length.
157	
158	_Video 1. Key differences between the NVIDIA Vera Rubin compute tray and the NVIDIA Grace Blackwell compute tray_
159	
160	The compute trays inside the Vera Rubin NVL72 are completely redesigned from NVIDIA Blackwell. It features a robust PCB midplane designed to fit in a single-wide rack that unlocks a cable-free, hose-free, and fanless design. This simplification drops compute tray assembly time from nearly two hours to just five minutes—up to 20x faster assembly and serviceability.
161	
162	Each compute tray features two [NVIDIA Vera Rubin superchips](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/inside-the-nvidia-rubin-platform-six-new-chips-one-ai-supercomputer/#nvidia_vera_rubin_superchip%C2%A0) with 17,000 components each—approximately five times as many components as a modern smartphone. The superchips are connected to the front modular bays that house eight ConnectX-9 SuperNICs and one BlueField-4 DPU through the PCB midplane.
163	
164	![Image of the NVLink Switch tray showing four NVLink Switch chips.](https://developer-blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/nvidia-vera-rubin-nvlink-switch-tray-1.webp)_Figure 7. NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVLink Switch tray_
165	
166	Vera Rubin NVL72 introduces new rack-scale resiliency features designed to maximize uptime and goodput for large AI clusters. The NVLink switch trays support operational resiliency features that allow administrators to place switches into maintenance mode and replace them while the rack continues operating. The architecture also supports continued operation even if multiple switch trays are unavailable, minimizing disruption during maintenance.
167	
168	At the silicon level, NVIDIA Rubin GPUs continuously run nondisruptive health checks and NVIDIA Vera CPUs feature in-system testing and SOCAMM memory for faster serviceability. Together, these chip-to-rack innovations reduce operational overhead and build on the resiliency improvements seen with Blackwell clusters.
169	
170	### NVIDIA Vera Rubin Ultra NVL576 [Scroll to NVIDIA Vera Rubin Ultra NVL576 section](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/nvidia-vera-rubin-pod-seven-chips-five-rack-scale-systems-one-ai-supercomputer/\#nvidia_vera_rubin_ultra_nvl576)
171	
172	NVIDIA Vera Rubin Ultra introduces a new two-layer all-to-all NVLink topology that will enable developers to scale-up to 576 GPUs. Vera Rubin Ultra NVL576 will combine eight separate MGX NVL racks, each with 72 Rubin Ultra GPUs, all in a single 576-GPU NVLink domain with copper and direct optical connections. It will be built using the same MGX rack-scale ecosystem for fastest time to production.
173

Performance per watt improves approximately 1.5x on GB200 NVL72 and 1.3–1.4x on Vera Rubin NVL72.

138:[Vera Rubin NVL72 racks are designed for 45° C liquid-cooling inlet operation](https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/liquid-cooling-ai-factories/). Warmer liquid may sound counterintuitive, but the goal is to remove heat efficiently while meeting performance, reliability, and lifetime requirements. Higher coolant temperatures can enable facilities to rely more often on “free cooling,” which uses outside air or water to reject heat with minimal mechanical chilling.
162:Physical infrastructure is difficult to change once built. Whether upgrading an existing facility or planning NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 sites, operators should retrofit or design for [NVIDIA DSX MaxLPS](https://docs.nvidia.com/dsx/maxlps) at the site level, even if they do not deploy every rack on Day 1. That means validating power topology, redundancy, cooling behavior, telemetry availability, policy requirements, network capacity, rack-position optionality, and space or utility constraints before infrastructure decisions are fixed.
164:For teams evaluating the software path, the [NVIDIA Dynamic Power Software documentation](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/dps/versions/0.8/) and [NVL72 inference power pilot](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/dps/versions/0.8/guides/runbooks/maxlps-simple-mode-pilot/) provide a starting point. A scoped validation compares an unmanaged static baseline against a MaxLPS-managed run using representative workloads, tracking throughput, latency, service error rate, power draw, utilization, and policy compliance. The results show operators when and how fast to scale as they prepare for Vera Rubin NVL72.
170:NVIDIA DSX MaxLPS addresses this on three fronts: dynamic power allocation software that unlocks stranded rack capacity, performance-per-watt techniques that raise output per watt, and 45° C thermal and facility design that reduces cooling overhead while preserving the physical optionality to land more compute. For operators planning Vera Rubin NVL72 deployments, MaxLPS is a path to prepare sites for up to 40% more Rubin GPU capacity within fixed power budgets.

--- claim.ts ---
import type { Claim, ClaimValue, Confidence, EvidenceType, ProductStatus } from './types'

/**
 * Claim 构造小工具。纯函数、返回纯对象（模块加载期求值），不破坏 JSON 可序列化。
 * 目的只有一个：让内容文件里「每个数字都带出处」写起来不痛苦，从而不会有人图省事去写裸数字。
 */

export const RA_SOURCE = 'src.nvidia-nvl72-ra'
export const GB300_PAGE_SOURCE = 'src.nvidia-gb300-page'
/** NVIDIA 官方页面抓取时间。 */
export const NVIDIA_ASOF = '2026-08'

interface ClaimInit<T extends ClaimValue> {
  value: T | null
  sourceId: string
  unit?: string | null
  evidence?: EvidenceType
  status?: ProductStatus
  locator?: string | null
  asOf?: string
  confidence?: Confidence
  note?: string | null
}

export function claim<T extends ClaimValue>(init: ClaimInit<T>): Claim<T> {
  return {
    value: init.value,
    unit: init.unit ?? null,
    evidence: init.evidence ?? 'verified_spec',
    status: init.status ?? 'shipping',
    sourceId: init.sourceId,
    locator: init.locator ?? null,
    asOf: init.asOf ?? NVIDIA_ASOF,
    confidence: init.confidence ?? 'high',
    note: init.note ?? null,
  }
}

/** NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 企业参考架构文档中的确切规格。 */
export function raSpec<T extends ClaimValue>(
  value: T | null,
  unit: string | null,
  locator: string,
  note: string | null = null,
): Claim<T> {
  return claim<T>({ value, unit, sourceId: RA_SOURCE, locator, note })
}

/** 关键数量：locator 必填，保证任何时候都能回查官方文档的具体表格/段落。 */
export function raCount(value: number, locator: string, note: string | null = null): Claim<number> {
  return claim<number>({ value, unit: '个', sourceId: RA_SOURCE, locator, note })
}

/** NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 产品页规格表中的确切规格。 */
export function pageSpec<T extends ClaimValue>(
  value: T | null,
  unit: string | null,
  locator: string,
  note: string | null = null,
): Claim<T> {
  return claim<T>({ value, unit, sourceId: GB300_PAGE_SOURCE, locator, note })
}

/** 厂商宣称（营销口径，非可验证规格）——UI 上要与 verified_spec 明显区分。 */
export function vendorClaim<T extends ClaimValue>(
  value: T | null,
  unit: string | null,
  sourceId: string,
  locator: string,
  note: string | null = null,
): Claim<T> {
  return claim<T>({ value, unit, sourceId, locator, evidence: 'vendor_claim', confidence: 'medium', note })
}

/**
 * 「官方未公布，本项目不编数」——value 恒为 null。
 * 下游必须把它渲染成 N/A 并显示 note，产能估算遇到它要走拒绝/降级门。
 */
export function notPublished(
  unit: string | null,
  sourceId: string,
  note: string,
  locator: string | null = null,
): Claim {
  return claim({
    value: null,
    unit,
    sourceId,
    locator,
    confidence: 'low',
    note,
  })
}
```

## AI for Science - From Training to Deployment

NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL4 is built for the AI-for-Science workflows that drive modern 
scientific discovery, including fine-tuning domain-specific models, generating 
and using synthetic data, accelerating simulations, and running high-throughput 
inference across large experimental spaces. With  2.5 TB of fast-access memory in 
a single compute node, NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL4 delivers up to 6x faster training on 
models like GPT3-175B and Llama 3.1 405B and up to 8x faster inference on Llama 2 
70B versus Grace Hopper, giving researchers the power to build bigger models and 
the speed to put them to work.

The NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform delivers rack-scale resiliency with 
advanced reliability features. NVIDIA Rubin GPUs feature a dedicated 
second-generation RAS engine for proactive maintenance and realtime health checks without downtime. NVIDIA Vera CPUs add enhanced 
serviceability with small-outline compression-attached memory 
modules (SOCAMM) LPDDR5X and in-system tests for the CPU cores. 
The rack introduces modular, cable-free tray designs for 18x faster

intelligent resiliency and software-defined NVLink routing, which 
ensures continuous operation and reduces maintenance overhead.

The third-generation NVIDIA MGX rack architecture sets the production standard 
for AI infrastructure with engineering breakthroughs across mechanical, power, and 
cooling design. Built for the resiliency and energy efficiency AI factories demand, 
its single-wide, PCB-based design unlocks fully modular, cable-free, hose-free, and 
fanless compute and NVLink switch trays—paired with operational resiliency features 
that support swapping switch trays without interrupting rack operation. Dynamic 
power steering routes power between CPUs, GPUs, and NVLink switch trays based 
on real-time demand, while Intelligent Power Smoothing uses rack-level capacitors 
to cushion the steep load swings from AI workloads. And with 100% liquid cooling 
engineered for 45°C warm-water inlet temperatures, MGX drops seamlessly into 
existing liquid-cooled data centers and enables ambient-air, dry-cooler designs that 
reduce PUE and redirect power from cooling overhead to token generation.

NVIDIA-Certified Storage #
This Enterprise Reference Architecture is designed to support high performance storage solutions that can keep pace with GPU intensive AI workloads. As a guideline, the architecture allocates approximately 12.5 Gb/s per GPU, scaling linearly as the cluster grows—for example, a 16 GPU cluster would require around 200 Gb/s of aggregate storage bandwidth. For validated storage systems and deployment guidance tailored to your cluster size, refer to the NVIDIA-Certified Storage program , which integrates seamlessly with this reference architecture.
The NVIDIA-Certified Storage program provides a comprehensive validation framework that ensures storage platforms meet stringent performance, quality, and interoperability standards for AI workloads. Partner solutions undergo extensive functional and performance testing to guarantee predictable deployment, energy efficiency, and operational consistency for end-to-end AI factories.

# GB300 NVL72 数据核验报告

核验范围：`dump-sys.gb300-nvl72.json` 全部 keySpecs / countClaim / bandwidth，加上 `src/data/gb300-nvl72.ts` 与 `src/data/shared.ts` 里对应的组件 `specs` / `summary` / `presalesNote`（dump 的 `components` 数组为空，故直接读源文件补齐）。所有官方页面均已实访抓取。

---

## 严重度：高

### H1. 系统 `presalesNote` 的「慢 18 倍」是双向/单向口径混用，官方数据推出的是 9 倍
- **应用原值**：`system.presalesNote`（`sys.gb300-nvl72`）——「不必走慢 18 倍的以太网出机架」
- **官方原文**：RA 明确 NVLink 是「with a bandwidth of 900GB/s (1800 GB/s bi-directional)」（[network-logical-architecture.html](https://docs.nvidia.com/enterprise-reference-architectures/nvl72-ai-factory/latest/network-logical-architecture.html)）；网卡是「Each ConnectX-8 SuperNIC offers up to 800 Gb/s」（[components.html](https://docs.nvidia.com/enterprise-reference-architectures/nvl72-ai-factory/latest/components.html)）
- **问题**：18 = 1800 GB/s（**双向**）÷ 100 GB/s（网卡**单向**）。同口径应为 900÷100 = **9 倍**。NVIDIA 全站没有任何「18x」的 NVLink/以太网对比（RA 里唯一的 "18x" 是 "18x 100G/200G storage connections"）。
- **建议修正**：改为「慢约 9 倍」，或不给倍数、直接说「NVLink 每卡 1.8 TB/s 双向 vs 网卡 800 Gb/s」。

### H2. 「参考架构未给出交换机台数」是错的——官方明确给了，且给到每机架级
- **应用原值**：`cmp.gb300.sn5610.specs.switchesPerRack` = `notPublished`，note「参考架构未给出每机架/每 POD 的交换机台数」；同一说法复制到 `asm.gb300.scaleout-spine.note`（「台数取决于 SU 规模与收敛比，参考架构未给定值」）
- **官方原文**：「Each rack requires 2x SN5600 switches for CPU and storage connectivity」，同段还写 "up to 12x SN5600 switches for the dual-plane GPU network"（[network-logical-architecture.html](https://docs.nvidia.com/enterprise-reference-architectures/nvl72-ai-factory/latest/network-logical-architecture.html)）。另有 Table 6（计算网 leaf/spine：2 SU→8/4、4 SU→16/8、8 SU→32/12）、Table 7（汇聚网 leaf/spine：2 SU→2/N.A.、4 SU→4/2、8 SU→7/4）、Appendix Table 11（compute core fabric 12/12/24/24/32/32/44/44）
- **建议修正**：把 `switchesPerRack` 改为已发布，引 Table 6/7/11；spine/leaf 装配 note 改为按 SU 规模引官方数值。

### H3. 交换机型号：应用全线用 SN5610，而 RA 的拓扑表 / BOM / 三个设计点一律写 SN5600 128 口 400 Gb/s，冲突未留痕
- **应用原值**：`cmp.gb300.sn5610`（名称、64 端口、800 Gb/s），并被 `asm.gb300.scaleout-leaf/spine/converged-switch` 三处复用；`scene.gb300.learn-switch-layers.narration` 直接教销售说「三层用的是同一款 SN5610（64 端口 × 800 Gb/s）」
- **官方原文**：Table 5 写「NVIDIA SN5600 128-port 400 Gb/s switches」（compute 与 converged 两行均是），Appendix Table 11 亦写 SN5600；只有 networking-hardware.html 一页写 SN5610「64 total ports of 800 Gbps」
- **统计**：SN5600 在 RA 出现 5 次（appendix ×2、network-logical-architecture ×3），SN5610 出现 4 次（仅 networking-hardware 一页）
- **建议修正**：这与 `sources.ts` 已为 HGX RA 记录的第③条内部不一致是同一性质的问题，NVL72 RA 也有。应在 `src.nvidia-nvl72-ra.note` 与 `cmp.gb300.sn5610.note` 留痕，场景叙述改为「RA 内部同时出现 SN5600/SN5610 两种写法」。

### H4. ConnectX-8「每托盘推荐 800 GB/s」与 RA 自己给出的每托盘 3200 Gb/s 直接矛盾，且把官方的「per GPU」改写成了「每节点（托盘）」
- **应用原值**：`cmp.gb300.connectx-8.specs.recommendedComputeBandwidthGBs` = 800 GB/s，note「这是每节点（托盘）的推荐计算网总带宽；最低要求为 400 GB/s」
- **官方原文**：标题句是「total compute network bandwidth per GPU recommendations」（不是 per node）；而 RA 给出的每托盘实际值是「a total aggregate bandwidth of 3200 Gb/s」＝ **400 GB/s**（[network-logical-architecture.html](https://docs.nvidia.com/enterprise-reference-architectures/nvl72-ai-factory/latest/network-logical-architecture.html) SU 一节）
- **判读**：800 GB/s 对应「16x 400 Gb/s Ethernet NICs」，即 8-GPU 节点口径，明显是从 HGX（2-8-9-800）那份 RA 搬来的段落；按 GB300 每托盘 4 GPU 算，实际就是 400 GB/s。应用取了 800 并标成「每托盘推荐」，是这批数据里最容易被懂行客户当场拆穿的一条。
- **建议修正**：改标为 400 GB/s（引 SU 节 3200 Gb/s），并在 note 中记录 RA 该段「per GPU / 16 NIC」措辞与 GB300 托盘形态不符。

---

## 严重度：中

### M1. 「Blackwell Ultra 相对 B200 主要加的是显存而不是算力」与官方产品页冲突
- **应用原值**：`cmp.gb300.b300-gpu.presalesNote`
- **官方原文**：「delivers 1.5x more dense FP4 Tensor Core FLOPS and 2x higher attention performance」，另一段「1.5x larger HBM3E memory in combination with added AI compute」（[产品页](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/gb300-nvl72/)）
- **问题**：官方口径是显存 1.5x、稠密 FP4 算力也 1.5x，两者同幅提升，并非「主要加显存」。
- **建议修正**：改为「显存与稠密 FP4 算力同为 1.5x，注意力层再 2x」。

### M2. 整条液冷链（CDU / 歧管 / 冷板 / 快接头）在 RA 中零出现，却统一挂 `src.nvidia-nvl72-ra`
- **应用原值**：`asm.gb300.cdu` / `manifold` / `tray-cold-plate` / `nvswitch-cold-plate`，5 条 cooling 连接的 `sourceIds` 全为 `["src.nvidia-nvl72-ra"]`；`cmp.shared.cdu/manifold/cold-plate` 同样只挂 RA_SOURCE
- **核验结果**：对抓取到的 RA 六页做全文检索，`CDU`、`manifold`、`cold plate`、`coolant`、`quick disconnect` 命中数均为 **0**
- **官方原文只到这一层**：「the GB300 NVL72 rack is liquid cooled, based on the MGX architecture」与「Integrated tray-level and rack-level liquid leakage detection」
- **问题**：「托盘冷板经快接头挂歧管，支持单托盘维护而不停整机架」「CDU 负责恒温恒压与流量分配」这类表述在 RA 里没有任何出处。技术上通用正确，但溯源是假的。
- **建议修正**：把这些连接/组件的 sourceIds 改为空或标为示意建模，note 注明「RA 未描述二次侧回路细节」。

### M3. 机架「承重 >1.3 吨」无出处，且与同组件 `weightKg = notPublished` 自相矛盾
- **应用原值**：`cmp.shared.oberon-rack.presalesNote`「客户最关心的两件事是承重（>1.3 吨量级）」；同组件 `weightKg: notPublished(..., '参考架构未公布整机重量。')`
- **建议修正**：删除该数字，或换成非量化表述（「整机重量以吨计，须与机房核对楼板承重」）。

### M4. 「冗余度接近 2N」与同组件 `redundancyMode = notPublished` 自相矛盾
- **应用原值**：`cmp.gb300.power-shelf.presalesNote`「8 架 × 33 kW = 264 kW…冗余度接近 2N」；同组件 note 写「参考架构未声明冗余模式（N+1 / 2N）」
- **官方原文**：只有「8 power shelves of 33 kW, with each shelf having six 5.5 kW PSUs」与「Full rack requiring up to 142 kW」
- **问题**：264/142 ≈ 1.86 是容量余量，推不出 2N 拓扑（2N 是供电路径冗余概念）。
- **建议修正**：改为「装机容量 264 kW 对最高 142 kW 负载留有约 1.9 倍余量；官方未声明冗余拓扑」。

### M5. 托盘 BMC 端口速率被标成「官方未单独公布」，但 RA 其实公布了，还给了每托盘 3 口
- **应用原值**：`con.gb300.tray-bmc-mgmt` 的 locator 走的是「Table 2: Management Node Components」，note 写「托盘 BMC 口速率未单独公布，此处按同级别标注」
- **官方原文**：「18 trays, each with 3x 1Gb/s connections providing 54 x 1Gb/s」（SU 一节）；OOB 一节另有「The SN2201 is used to connect to the BMC/OOB 1 Gb/s ports」
- **建议修正**：locator 改引 network-logical-architecture SU 节，删掉「未公布」的 caveat，并可把「每托盘 3 个 1 Gb/s / 每 SU 54 个」补进管理平面场景。

### M6. 官方 Overview 首句的结构口径「2-4-5-800」应用完全缺失
- **官方原文**：「2-4-5-800 (dual plane) node architecture」（[overview.html](https://docs.nvidia.com/enterprise-reference-architectures/nvl72-ai-factory/latest/overview.html) 第一句）
- **问题**：`sources.ts` 已经为 HGX RA 记录了对应的「2-8-9-800」，NVL72 这条同级口径（2 CPU / 4 GPU / 5 张网卡 / 每 GPU 800 Gb/s）却没进任何 Claim 或 note。这是最适合售前对照两个代际的一句话。
- **建议修正**：补进 `src.nvidia-nvl72-ra.note` 与 `cmp.gb300.compute-tray`。

### M7. 三处 locator 的「」引文不是原文（改写后当逐字引用用）
| 位置 | 应用写的「引文」 | 官方实际措辞 |
|---|---|---|
| `cmp.gb300.connectx-8.dualPlaneSplit`、`con.gb300.cx8-leaf` | 「this splits into 2x400 Gb/s interfaces, with each interface connecting to a different leaf switch」 | "breaking the interface to 2x400 Gb/s interfaces"＋"Every such interface is then connected to a different leaf switch"（两句被合并改写） |
| `cmp.gb300.sn5610.specs.roles` | 「Serves Compute (East/West), Customer and Storage (North/South)…」 | "to provide connectivity for Compute (East/West), Customer and Storage (North/South)"（原文无 "Serves"） |
| `con.gb300.bf3-converged` | 「Each compute tray connects using dual 400 Gb/s ports to two separate switches」 | "Each compute tray connects to two separate switches using dual 400 Gb/s ports"（语序被改） |

三条的**数值与事实都对**，只是引文不忠实。若 locator 的定位是「可逐字回查」，这三处需要按原文改回。

### M8. NVLink 1800 GB/s 未标「双向」
- **应用原值**：`cmp.gb300.b300-gpu.specs.nvlinkPerGpuGBs` = 1800 GB/s，无 note；`con.gb300.gpu-nvswitch` 靠 `direction: bidirectional` 隐含
- **官方原文**：components.html 只写「delivering up to 1800 GB/s per GPU」，但 network-logical-architecture 补充「a bandwidth of 900GB/s (1800 GB/s bi-directional)」
- **建议修正**：给该 spec 加 note「1800 GB/s 为双向合计，单向 900 GB/s」——这也是 H1 的根因。

---

## 严重度：低

- **L1. RA 两张表写的是 "HBM3" 不是 HBM3e**：Table 1「NVIDIA B300 GPU, with 1,152 GB aggregated HBM3 memory」、Table 10 同。应用与产品页均作 HBM3e/HBM3E（产品页有 "High-Capacity HBM3E Architecture" 小节），**应用取值正确**，但 `hbmPerGpuGB.note` 只记了 720 GB 冲突、没记 HBM3 写法。
- **L2. 50x 的 note 措辞不准**：应用 note 说「含功耗与成本因子的综合产出比」。官方拆解是「10x boost in user responsiveness (TPS per user) and a 5x improvement in throughput」（TPS per MW），**没有成本因子**。建议改为「10x 单用户响应 × 5x 每兆瓦吞吐」。
- **L3. `nvlinkScaleUp` 键名与所引原文相反**：RA 原文是「The compute tray is a fully integrated NVLink scale-out architecture」，产品页则说 NVLink「is a scale–up interconnect」。应用采信了产品页（正确），但未在 note 里说明 RA 这句是官方笔误。
- **L4. 无来源传闻进了 presalesNote**：`cmp.gb300.compute-tray.presalesNote`「也有 1:2 的其他形态在传」——「在传」不是可引用的东西，建议删。
- **L5.「Oberon 形态」在 RA 中零出现**：`cmp.shared.oberon-rack` 名称含 Oberon，但只挂 RA_SOURCE，而 RA 只说「based on the MGX architecture」。建议改名为 MGX，或补一个真正提到 Oberon 的官方源。
- **L6. 系统 presalesNote 与 Overview 措辞相抵**：应用说「它不是 18 台服务器摆在一个柜子里」；官方 Overview 说「(each tray) can still operate independently as needed」。官方的口径是「既可独立、也可合体」，建议软化为「可以当 18 台用，但真正的价值在于合成一台」。
- **L7. BlueField-3 的 480 Gb/s 上限未进场景叙述，且 RA 另有第三个数**：组件 spec 已正确记「can handle an aggregate bandwidth of approximately 480 Gb/s」并记了 Appendix「400 GB/s」的单位笔误，但**没记** SU 一节的第三个说法「a total aggregate bandwidth of 800 Gb/s」。业务平面场景只讲「双 400 Gb/s」，客户容易自行相加成 800。

---

## 已核验为正确的关键事实

以下均与官方原文逐字一致，locator 指向真实存在的位置，evidence 分级合规（全部引 `official_doc`）：

- 72 GPU / 36 Grace CPU / 18 计算托盘 / 8 SU 上限 —— 四条 locator 写的「Overview」确实存在于 `overview.html`，引文逐字吻合（含「36 NVIDIA® Grace CPUs」的 ® 号）
- 9 NVSwitch 托盘、每托盘 2 颗 ASIC、合计 18 颗；每 GPU 18 条 NVLink「one per in-rack NVSwitch via the copper backplane」
- NVLink 域聚合 130 TB/s（RA 与产品页同值）
- 整机架 up to 142 kW；8 电源架 × 33 kW；每架 6 × 5.5 kW PSU
- 2 台机架内 SN2201；机架内走母排直流、机架外走交流
- Table 1 全四行数量：Grace ×2、B300 ×4、夹层板 ×2（每板 2 颗 CX-8）、BlueField-3 ×1
- 每托盘 1 块 M.2（2 TB Gen4）、4 块 E1.S ——**且应用已正确标注 Appendix Table 10「8 x 4 TB E1.S」的官方内部冲突**
- 每 GPU 288 GB HBM（Table 1「1,152 GB aggregated」÷4）——**且应用已正确标注 Appendix Table 10「720 GB」的官方内部冲突**
- 12 台控制面管理节点；4× ConnectX-7 200G 单口（另被「four 200 Gb/s ports」二次佐证）
- ConnectX-8 每张 800 Gb/s、1:1 GPU:NIC、拆 2×400 Gb/s 上两个平面、每平面可扩到 1024 个 400 Gb/s 接口、故障切换由网卡硬件完成
- 每托盘存储带宽上限 40 GB/s；BlueField-3 双 400 Gb/s 接两台交换机；BF-3 板载 BMC 1 Gb/s 带外口
- SN5610 64 口 800 Gbps、2 个 SFP28；SN2201 48 口
- 产品页规格表全部数值：20 TB / 576 TB/s / 17 TB LPDDR5X / 37 TB / 2,592 核 / FP4 1440|1080（脚注 2 "Without sparsity."）/ FP8 720（脚注 1 含稀疏）
- 50x vs Hopper 的引文逐字正确，且已按 `vendor_claim` 降级 + 加了警示 note
- 液冷（"fully liquid-cooled"）与「NVLink 是 scale-up」的定性正确，未与官方说反
- `cmp.gb300.b300-gpu.mathSpecs` 的四条折算全部可复算：288 GB = 1152÷4；8 TB/s = 576÷72；15 PFLOPS = 1080÷72；5 PFLOPS = 720÷2÷72

/**
 * URL 参数 → store 的**一次性**播种。
 *
 * 三个用途：
 * 1. 深链——`/?level=board&focus=asm.gb300.b300-gpu` 直接把人送到某一屏，
 *    汇报时不用现场点五下；
 * 2. **学习手册的任务卡**（v1.3 W2）——`?tour=scene.gb300.learn-plane-nvlink`
 *    一步落到某个导览站（层级、焦点、平面、讲解文案、场景高亮一次到位），
 *    手册里每张练习卡的「▶ 打开」就是这个参数；
 * 3. 截图/E2E 的确定性入口——`?motion=off&gl=off` 可以关掉相机动画与 WebGL，
 *    让 Playwright 基线不受动画时序影响。
 *
 * 「一次性」很重要：播种之后用户的手动操作不应该被 URL 覆盖，
 * 因此这里不做双向同步（URL ← store 的回写留给后续批次按需加）。
 */

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { assemblyById, sceneById, scenesOfSystem, systemById } from '../data'
import type { LodLevel, NetworkPlane } from '../data/types'
import { LEVEL_ORDER } from '../lib/drill'
import { PLANE_ORDER } from '../lib/palette'
import { detectWebGL } from '../lib/webgl'
import { useFactoryStore } from '../store'
import type { ExplorerMode, PlaneFlags } from '../store'

export interface ShotParams {
  level: LodLevel | null
  focus: string | null
  planes: NetworkPlane[] | null
  motionOff: boolean
  glOff: boolean
  /** `?gen=sys.vera-rubin-nvl72`：直接落到某一代际。 */
  generation: string | null
  /** `?mode=compare`：直接进比较模式。 */
  mode: ExplorerMode | null
  /** `?right=sys.rubin-ultra-nvl576`：比较模式的右侧代际。 */
  compareRight: string | null
  /** `?tour=scene.gb300.learn-plane-nvlink`：直接落到某个导览站（v1.3 W2）。 */
  tour: string | null
}

const MODES: readonly ExplorerMode[] = ['explore', 'compare', 'tour']

/** 纯解析，不碰 store。 */
export function parseShotParams(search: string): ShotParams {
  const q = new URLSearchParams(search)
  const rawLevel = q.get('level')
  const level = rawLevel && (LEVEL_ORDER as readonly string[]).includes(rawLevel)
    ? (rawLevel as LodLevel)
    : null

  const rawPlanes = q.get('planes')
  const planes = rawPlanes
    ? rawPlanes
        .split(',')
        .map((s) => s.trim())
        .filter((s): s is NetworkPlane => (PLANE_ORDER as readonly string[]).includes(s))
    : null

  const rawMode = q.get('mode')
  const mode = rawMode && (MODES as readonly string[]).includes(rawMode) ? (rawMode as ExplorerMode) : null

  return {
    level,
    focus: q.get('focus'),
    planes,
    motionOff: q.get('motion') === 'off',
    glOff: q.get('gl') === 'off',
    generation: q.get('gen'),
    mode,

```text
NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX serves models at ultrafast interactivity with long context using its compiler-scheduled workload planning. This includes its chip-to-chip (C2C) within-rack networking and its ability to heavily overlap compute with interprocessor communication.

### Tightly scheduled interchip communication [Scroll to Tightly scheduled interchip communication section](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/how-nvidia-groq-3-lpx-unlocks-ultrafast-interactivity-at-long-context-on-nvidia-vera-rubin/\#tightly_scheduled_interchip_communication)

Groq 3 LPX uses a deterministic execution model. This means the compiler has visibility into:

- The individual compute units in each of the 256 LP30 local processing units (LPUs)
- The 128 GB of total SRAM-based memory collectively in those chips
- The 96 C2C links per chip running at 112 Gbps each

It can use this information to produce a schedule, down-to-the-clock cycle of exactly how the workload will run before it begins.

This has many advantages. Most relevant to high interactivity, it eliminates the need for real-time arbitration of transfers because it can plan when each piece of data will move over each C2C link, producing a data transfer schedule like the one shown in Figure 3, before the workload begins.

![Animation of three LPU chips exchanging data along green compiler-scheduled routes that flow continuously without stopping or contending for the link. ](https://developer-blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/three-lpu-chips-data-exchange.gif)_Figure 3. Illustrative schedule of C2C transfers produced by the Groq 3 LPX compiler prior to the workload running, just as in a smart city, pedestrians, bicyclists, and cars travel optimally without needing to stop for each other in real time_

Further, this preworkload scheduling enables a fundamental shift in the way data transfers occur. Many systems have several steps for each transfer, even for small pieces of data:

- One chip may make a request to transfer data
- Another chip may confirm the data is available to transfer and locate it
- The data may have to contend with other pieces of data being transferred at the same time

By contrast, the compiler-produced schedule means that LPUs can send data on the clock cycle when it is ready, and consume the data on the clock cycle when it arrives, as shown in Figure 4.

# HGX B300 事实核验报告

## 严重度：高

### 1. 「18 倍带宽 / 1‑18」这个招牌比值与 NVIDIA 自己同一张表的数字差一倍

**应用原值**（出现 5 处，均为对客话术核心）：
- `sys.hgx-b300.keySpecs.perGpuNetworkGbs.note`（hgx-b300.ts:273-274）：「与机架内 NVLink 的 1.8 TB/s（= 14,400 Gb/s）对照：跨服务器带宽是域内的 **1/18**」「**域内 18 倍带宽**这个比值就是……的全部答案」
- `con.hgx.cx8-leaf.summary`（:2008）「相比是 **1/18** 的带宽」
- `scene.hgx.rack-no-nvlink.narration`（:2351）「中间差 **18 倍**带宽」
- `scene.hgx.two-domains.narration`（:2388）「走 **1/18** 带宽的以太网」
- `asm.hgx.scaleout-leaf.note`（:1582）「慢一个数量级」

**官方原文**（HGX 平台页 NVIDIA Blackwell 规格表，HGX B300 列，同一张表相邻两行）：
> `Total NVLink Bandwidth | 14.4 TB/s`
> `Networking Bandwidth | 1.6 TB/s`
（https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/hgx/）

14.4 ÷ 1.6 = **9**，不是 18。NVIDIA 的「Networking Bandwidth」按双向计（B300：800 Gb/s × 2 × 8 卡 = 1.6 TB/s；同表 B200 为 400 Gb/s × 2 × 8 = 0.8 TB/s，两行自洽），与「Total NVLink Bandwidth 14.4 TB/s」是同一口径。应用的 18 倍是把**双向**的 NVLink 1.8 TB/s 与**单向口径**的 800 Gb/s 相除得到的，混了口径。技术博客对 NVLink 的措辞也明说是双向：
> `Per-GPU Bandwidth: 1.8 TB/s bidirectional (18 links x 100 GB/s)`
（https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/inside-nvidia-blackwell-ultra-the-chip-powering-the-ai-factory-era/）

**建议修正值**：改为 **9 倍 / 1‑9**，并把出处换成 HGX 平台页那两行（14.4 TB/s vs 1.6 TB/s，同表同口径，最不容易被挑战）。若坚持用「1.8 TB/s vs 800 Gb/s」，必须在同一句里写明「前者双向、后者单口线速」，否则在技术评审里必被问倒——这恰是该系统自己最怕的场景。
（不确定性说明：官方从未发布过这个比值本身，9× 是我从官方同表两行推的；18× 则需要跨口径相除。）

---

### 2. 三处 HGX 语境里写了「机架内 NVLink」，与本系统的招牌教学主张自相矛盾

**应用原值**：
- hgx-b300.ts:273 `keySpecs.perGpuNetworkGbs.note`：「与**机架内 NVLink** 的 1.8 TB/s 对照」
- hgx-b300.ts:1582 `asm.hgx.scaleout-leaf.note`：「仍然比**机架内 NVLink** 慢一个数量级」
- hgx-b300.ts:2008 `con.hgx.cx8-leaf.summary`：「与**机架内 NVLink** 的 1.8 TB/s 相比」

这三处的 1.8 TB/s 指的都是 HGX B300 自己的 NVLink，而同一个系统的 `scene.hgx.rack-no-nvlink` 标题就叫「机架里没有 NVLink：切到这个平面，一条线都没有」。

**官方原文**（RA Components 节）：
> `8 Blackwell GPUs internally connected by NVLink and externally connected by`… 800 Gb/s Ethernet
（https://docs.nvidia.com/enterprise-reference-architectures/hgx-ai-factory/latest/components.html）
分界线是**基板 / 服务器**，不是机架。全份 RA 中 NVLink 只出现在 Abstract 和 baseboard 两处，均为服务器内语义。

**建议修正值**：这三处改为「**服务器内 NVLink**」或「**基板上的 NVLink**」。
（注：hgx-b300.ts:221 与 :1096 的「机架内 NVLink」指的是 NVL72，用法正确，不要一起改。）

---

## 严重度：中

### 3. `switchCount32Node` 的括注「汇聚核心网另有 12 台」与本系统 `asm.hgx.converged-switch` 的 countClaim=2 直接打架

**应用原值**：`cmp.hgx.sn5600.specs.switchCount32Node`（:1145）值 12，note 写「（汇聚核心网另有 12 台）」；同时 `asm.hgx.converged-switch.countClaim.value = 2`。

**官方原文**（两处互相冲突，均已实证）：
- appendix Table 9：`NVIDIA Spectrum-4 SN5600 Ethernet switch, converged core fabric | 12 | 24 | 48`
- network-logical-architecture Table 7，Nodes=32 行：`Leaf | 2`、`Spine | N/A`
（appendix-node-configurations.html / network-logical-architecture.html）

计算网侧两表闭合（8 leaf + 4 spine = 12 ✓），汇聚网侧不闭合（12 vs 2）——Table 9 的 converged 行看起来是 compute 行的复制粘贴事故。

**建议修正值**：countClaim 保持 2（Table 7 有 leaf/spine 拆解、且与 32 节点正文「Cost-efficient converged two-switch fabric」一致，证据更强）；但 `switchCount32Node` 的括注必须改成留痕式措辞，例如「⚠️ appendix Table 9 的『converged core fabric 12』与 Table 7 的『Leaf 2 / Spine N/A』冲突，本项目取 Table 7」。现在的写法把 12 当既成事实陈述，等于在同一份数据里给出两个互斥答案。

---

### 4. 「双平面负载均衡由 ConnectX-8 硬件完成」——RA 同一页另一节说是 NCCL 在主机上做

**应用原值**：`con.hgx.leaf-spine.summary`（:2028 附近）「由 ConnectX-8 在硬件层做负载均衡与故障切换」；`cmp.hgx.connectx-8.presalesNote`（:1011）同款措辞；`cmp.hgx.connectx-8.specs.dualPlaneSplit.note` 也只引硬件那一句。

**官方原文**（networking-physical-topologies.html，同页两节）：
- Multi Plane Topology Approach：`the resiliency and the load balancing between the two planes is handled by the NCCL on the host`
- Dual Plane Topology：`load balancing, and failure handling is handled by the ConnectX-8 SuperNIC on the hardware level`

**建议修正值**：不改数值，但在这三处加一句留痕：「⚠️ RA 同页 Multi Plane 一节写的是『handled by the NCCL on the host』，两说并存」。这是个会被懂行客户当场追问的点。

---

## 严重度：低

### 5. SN2201 在 128 节点设计点：正文 32 台 vs appendix 16 台，应用只取了 32 且未留痕

- 应用原值：`asm.hgx.oob-fabric-switch.countClaim.note`「64 节点起改为每 SU 一台（8 台 / **32 台**）」
- 官方：正文 128 节点 Management 段 `NVIDIA SN2201 switch per SU (32 switches total)`；appendix Table 9 `SN2201 leaf switches for OOB management fabric | 4 | 8 | 16`
- 建议：32 节点的 countClaim=4 两处一致、无需动；note 里的「32 台」加一句「⚠️ appendix Table 9 该列写 16，与正文冲突」。

### 6. 管理节点 200 GbE vs 400 GbE：RA 自相矛盾，应用把 200 当唯一事实

- 应用原值：`con.hgx.converged-control-plane` bandwidth 200 GbE，note 断言「⚠️ 与计算节点的双 400 GbE 不同，管理节点是双 200 GbE」
- 官方：network-logical-architecture `each management node is connected with two 200 GbE ports`；networking-physical-topologies `Each compute and management node is connected with two 400 GbE ports`
- 建议：**保留 200**（Table 3 的控制面 DPU 是 B3220「two 200G ports」，证据链更完整），但把 note 改成留痕式而非断言式。

### 7. `powerRedundancy` locator 把只在 32 节点段出现的半句挂到了三个设计点

- 应用原值（:1202-1203 与 :1244）：locator 写「32/64/128 三个设计点……『Rack layout must provide power supply redundancy; otherwise, consider an alternative rack layout』」
- 官方：完整含 `otherwise, consider an alternative rack layout` 的只有 32 节点段；64/128 段只有前半句
- 建议：locator 改为「32 节点段（64/128 节点段仅前半句）」。同一问题也影响 `keySpecs.rackPowerKW.note` 里的复述，但那处措辞是「另一句是」，问题较轻。

### 8. 「4 台约 56 kW，是当下风冷高密机架的常见档位」是无出处的行业断言，且偏乐观

- 应用原值：`asm.hgx.gpu-server.note` / `asm.hgx.rack.note` / `scene.hgx.rack-no-nvlink.narration`
- 官方无任何对应表述（DGX B300 的 `~14 kW` 只支撑 4×14≈56 kW 这步算术，不支撑「常见档位」这个判断）
- 建议：删掉「常见档位」这个评价，或改成同文件 `cmp.hgx.air-handler.presalesNote` 已有的稳妥说法——「每机架 40–60 kW 的风冷散热，气流组织撑不撑得住要问机电顾问」。

### 9. `cmp.hgx.b300-sxm.summary` 无保留地写「160 SM」

- 官方博客图 1 脚注：`Available SM count and HBM capacity varies by SKU`
- specs 里的 `smCount` 已有该保留（正确），summary 没有。建议 summary 加「（芯片满配口径）」四个字。

### 10. `cmp.hgx.sn5600.presalesNote` 的「同一代 Spectrum-4」「51.2 Tb/s 那一档」无出处

- RA 只把 **SN5600** 标为 Spectrum-4（appendix Table 9），从未说 SN5610 是哪一代，也从未出现 51.2 Tb/s
- 算术自洽（128×400G ≡ 64×800G ≡ 51.2 Tb/s），但属于应用自行补的外部知识
- 建议：保留结论，措辞改为「按端口数×速率折算总容量相同」，去掉未经官方确认的芯片代际断言。

### 11. `keySpecs.rackPowerKW`：`value: null` + `locator: null` 却挂 `evidence: "verified_spec"`

属项目 `hgxNull` 的全局约定（不是 HGX 专有问题），但严格说「没有值、没有定位符」不构成「已核验规格」。若后续做证据分级审计，这类条目建议单独一档。

### 12. 观察项（非错误）：同一代际里「机架」有两个含义

3D 按「1 机架 = 1 SU = 4 台」画（8 机架 = 32 台 = 官方 32 节点设计点 ✓ 闭合），而产能面板的「机架数」滑杆按 note 要读作「服务器台数」（`gpuCount` = 8 是每台）。`keySpecs.gpuCount.note` 已明确交代并给出了理由（8 恰是 NVLink 域边界，避免副本跨域），逻辑是对的，但同一屏里「机架」两义仍有误读风险。

---

## 已核验为正确的关键事实

**2‑8‑9‑800 与节点构成**（全部逐字命中）
- Abstract：`a 2-8-9-800 infrastructure configuration (2 CPUs, 8 GPUs, 9 NICs at 800 Gb/s bandwidth per GPU)` ✓ → cpuCount 2 / gpuCount 8 / nicCountPerNode 9 / perGpuNetworkGbs 800 全部正确，9 = 8 CX‑8 + 1 BF‑3 的拆解与 Table 2 + Table 5 完全吻合
- Table 2：`Eight NVIDIA® ConnectX-8 SuperNICs per NVIDIA HGX B300 baseboard` ✓（per **baseboard** 的措辞、"焊在基板上"的建模、`integrated onto the NVIDIA HGX B300 baseboard` 的引用全部准确）
- Table 2：`One NVIDIA® BlueField®-3 DPU per server` + Table 5 `One NVIDIA BlueField-3 B3240 dual port 400 GbE DPU` ✓；「DGX 是 2 张 BF‑3、HGX 是 1 张」的对照正确

**稀疏 / 稠密口径（重点核对项，全部正确）**
- HGX 平台页 HGX B300 列 `FP4 Tensor Core | 144 PFLOPS | 108 PFLOPS` + 脚注 1 `Specification in Sparse | Dense` → 应用取 **108 稠密** ✓
- `FP8/FP6 Tensor Core | 72 PFLOPS` + 脚注 2 `Dense is ½ sparse spec shown` → 应用登记 72 稀疏、note 注明稠密 36 ✓
- 单卡 mathSpecs 全部取自数据手册第 5 页 **HGX B300 列**，无一处串到 GB300 列：270 GB / 7.7 TB/s / FP4 稠密 14,000 TFLOPS / FP8 稠密 4,500 TFLOPS（= 9 ÷ 2）/ TDP 1,100 W ✓✓
- GB300 对照值 `20 PFLOPS | 15 PFLOPS`、`279 GB HBM3E | 8 TB/s`、`Configurable up to 1,400 W` 也逐字正确
- 「稀疏闭合 8×18=144 ✓、稠密不闭合 8×14=112≠108」这一自查结论属实，官方确实没解释

**显存三值并存的处理**：芯片博客 288 GB / 数据手册 GB300 列 279 GB / HGX B300 列 270 GB 三个数字均实证存在；博客图 1 脚注 `Available SM count and HBM capacity varies by SKU` 逐字正确，作为解释成立。RA Table 1 的 `288GB HBM3e` / `2.30TB HBM3e` / `Up to 64 TB/s` 与数据手册 2.1 TB / 62 TB/s 的分歧，应用的解释（上限口径 vs SKU 实配）与算术（8×270≈2.16 TB、8×7.7=61.6）均成立。

**规模与拓扑**
- Overview：`scales up to 128 NVIDIA-Certified HGX B300 systems for a total of 1024 B300 SXM GPUs` ✓；`A fully tested system scales to 32 SUs` ✓（32×4=128 闭合）
- `This Enterprise RA is built on scalable units (SU) based on 4 compute nodes` ✓
- Table 6 Nodes=32 行：Leaf **8** / Spine **4** / Uplinks per leaf **32** ✓，表下注 `Figures shown are aggregate amounts for both planes.` ✓；64 节点 16/8、128 节点 32/16 的 note 也对
- Table 7 Nodes=32 行：Leaf **2** / Spine **N/A** ✓；「64 节点起才有 spine（4+2）」✓
- 32 节点 Management：`SN2201 switch for every 2 SUs (4 switches total)` ✓，appendix Table 9 同为 4 ✓
- SU 三条连接：`64x 400Gb/s … 25.6Tb/s`、`8x 400Gb/s … 3.2Tb/s`、`24x 1Gb/s` 全部逐字正确

**风冷 / 液冷**：Abstract `industry-leading performance in an air-cooled form factor` ✓ 唯一一句；全份 RA 确无 CDU / 歧管 / 冷板 / 进液温度——「没有液冷」的断言成立，`liquidCooling: false` 正确。

**「机架 NVLink 平面为空」这一教学主张成立** ✓：全 RA（9 个页面）中 NVLink 只出现在 Abstract 与 baseboard 两处，均为服务器内语义；HGX 平台页对 B300 无任何外部 NVLink Switch System 选项；数据手册 HGX B300 列的 `Total NVLink Switch Bandwidth 14.4 TB/s` 就是 8 卡域的全部。该主张与官方无冲突（唯一问题是上面第 2 条的措辞自相矛盾）。

**HGX ≠ DGX 未被混淆** ✓：DGX B300 产品页 `Rack Units | 10U`、`Power Consumption | ~14 kW`、`NVIDIA NVLink™ Switch System | 2x`、`Intel® Xeon® 6776P Processors`、`2x dual-port QSFP112 NVIDIA BlueField-3 DPU` 五项逐字正确，且全部只出现在明确标注「DGX 参照 / 示意」的位置，没有一条进入 HGX 的 countClaim 或 mathSpecs。特别检查：`gpuMemoryPerNodeTB = 2.1 TB` **不是**借用 DGX 的数字——数据手册 HGX B300 列 `Total Fast Memory 2.1 TB` 与 HGX 平台页 `Total Memory 2.1 TB` 均为 HGX 自己的官方值。

**RA 自身三处内部矛盾的留痕全部属实**（我逐一复现）：① Table 2 的「CPU」「CPU sockets」两行确实被填成了 `Total Aggregate Bandwidth 14.4TB/s` / `GPU-to-GPU Bandwidth 1800GB/s`；② CPU 核数 Table 2 写 48、appendix Table 8 写 32（推荐值都是 56）；③ Table 5 / Table 9 写 SN5600（128‑port 400 GbE / Spectrum‑4）、networking-hardware 写 SN5610（`offers 64 total ports of 800 Gbps`）；另 appendix 表题确实误写成 `Table 8: RTX PRO Server system components`。

# Vera Rubin NVL72 数据核验报告

核验对象：`sys.vera-rubin-nvl72`（`/Users/caoruixin/projects/aifactory/src/data/vera-rubin-nvl72.ts`，共 74 条 Claim + 3 个场景）
方法：8 个指定 URL 全部实访（WebFetch + firecrawl-scrape），另补访 3 个官方源（数据手册 PDF、DSX MaxLPS 博客、2026-05-31 发布稿）。

---

## [严重度: 高] 1. 「NVLink 无线缆 / PCB 中板承载全部 NVLink 链路」与官方原文直接冲突

**应用原值**（多处）：
- `cmp.rubin.nvlink-midplane`.summary：「机架内的无源 PCB 中板，**承载计算托盘与 NVLink 6 交换托盘之间的全部链路**」
- `cmp.rubin.nvlink-midplane`.specs.**cableCount** = `null`，note「NVIDIA 未公布中板内部的链路根数」
- `cmp.rubin.nvlink-midplane`.presalesNote：「**没有线缆**意味着装配与更换托盘不需要重新走线」
- `con.rubin.nvswitch-midplane`.summary：「交换托盘的链路全部落在无源 PCB 中板上，**无线缆、无光模块**」
- `scene.rubin.rack-anatomy`.narration：「机架本体是第三代 MGX：单宽、**无线缆**、45°C 液冷」

**官方原文**（POD 博客「Compute and NVLink Switch trays」节 —— 正是应用引用其他事实的同一节）：
> "four modular preintegrated cable cartridges housing 5,000 copper cables over two miles in length"

上一句明确其归属：NVLink 6「delivers 3.6 TB/s ... 260 TB/s of scale-up bandwidth per rack. This high-speed data transfer happens in the NVLink spine at the back of the rack, which features ...」
URL: https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/nvidia-vera-rubin-pod-seven-chips-five-rack-scale-systems-one-ai-supercomputer/

**PCB 中板的官方职责是另一件事**，同节下一段：
> "The superchips are connected to the front modular bays that house eight ConnectX-9 SuperNICs and one BlueField-4 DPU through the PCB midplane."

即 PCB midplane 连的是**超级芯片 ↔ 前部网卡仓**；机架级 NVLink 走的是**后部铜缆脊柱**。应用 `specs.medium` 的 locator 恰好引用了这句，但省略号 `…` 正好吃掉了「that house eight ConnectX-9 SuperNICs and one BlueField-4 DPU」这个说明中板连什么的关键成分，随后被重新解读成 NVLink 机架结构。六芯片博客的计算托盘图注也写「NVLink 6 **spine** connectors」（https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/inside-the-nvidia-rubin-platform-six-new-chips-one-ai-supercomputer/）。

**注意「cable-free」的官方限定范围**：数据手册与产品页均写「cable-free modular **tray** designs」/「fully modular, cable-free, hose-free, and fanless compute and NVLink switch **trays**」——是托盘级，不是机架级。

**建议修正**：
- `cableCount` 由 `null` 改为 `5000`（'根'，源 VR_POD，locator 引上述原句）；
- `nvlink-midplane` 的 summary/presalesNote 改为「PCB 中板连接超级芯片与前部网卡仓；机架级 NVLink 走后部 4 个预集成线缆匣、约 5,000 根铜缆」；
- `con.rubin.nvswitch-midplane`.summary 删去「无线缆、无光模块」；
- 场景 narration 的「无线缆」改为「托盘无线缆」；
- note「GB300 一代对应的是铜背板」需重写：GB200/GB300 与 Vera Rubin 的机架 NVLink 脊柱**同为铜缆匣形态**，代际差异在托盘内部（cable-free tray），不在机架脊柱。

> 不确定项：官方没有说明这 5,000 根铜缆与 PCB 中板在电气上如何分工，也未说 midplane 是否完全不参与 NVLink。请按「官方两句话都要如实呈现」处理，不要用一句去否定另一句。

---

## [严重度: 高] 2. 「Preliminary information」脚注只覆盖 74 条 Claim 中的 2 条，且 UI 不渲染源登记表的 note

**官方原文**（产品页脚注 1，逐字）：
> "Preliminary information. All values are up to and subject to change."

URL: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/vera-rubin-nvl72/
DGX 页同类脚注（措辞略异，无「up to」）：「Preliminary information. All values are subject to change.」 https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/dgx-vera-rubin-nvl72/

**应用现状**：`PRELIMINARY` 常量（`vera-rubin-nvl72.ts:98`）只被用了 2 次 —— `keySpecs.gpuCount`(:122) 与 `cmp.rubin.rubin-gpu.specs.hbmPerGpuGB`(:255)。其余取自产品页/数据手册、**同样落在同一条脚注下**的十几条 Claim 都没有该 note，包括：`gpuMemoryTotalTB`(20.7)、`gpuMemoryBandwidthTBs`(1580)、`cpuMemoryTB`(54)、`fp4DensePflops`(2520)、`fp8DensePflops`(1260)、`fp4InferencePflops`(3600)、`cpuCoreCount`(3168)、`scaleOutBandwidthTBs`(28.8)、`totalChipCount`(1296)、`nvlinkAggregateBandwidthTBs`(260)、`c2cAggregateBandwidthTBs`(65)、`fastMemoryTB`(75)、`cpuCount`(36)。

**且传播路径已断**：`src/components/panels/DetailPanel.tsx` 的 `ClaimRow`(:218-246) 渲染 `claim.locator` 与 `claim.note`，`SourceLine`(:363) 只渲染 `source.title / publisher / asOf` —— **`SourceRef.note` 从不上屏**。因此 `sources.ts:50` 里那句脚注声明对最终用户不可见。用户看到的是一枚 `verified_spec` 证据条 + 一个不带任何预发布提示的数字。

**建议修正**：把 `PRELIMINARY` 追加到所有 sourceId 为 `VR_PAGE` / `VR_DGX` / `VR_DATASHEET` 的 Claim 的 note 上（或在 `vr()` 工厂里对这三个源自动注入）；另可让 `SourceLine` 渲染 `source.note`。

## [严重度: 中] 3. NVFP4 Inference 的稀疏口径官方已明确，应用却写「口径不明」

**应用原值**（`keySpecs.fp4InferencePflops`.note，`:182`）：
> 「⚠️ 该行**没有**脚注 2 的稠密标注，口径不明（很可能含稀疏）。」

**官方原文**（Vera Rubin 数据手册 PDF 脚注 1，逐字，比产品页多一句）：
> "Preliminary information. All values are up to and subject to change. **NVFP4 Inference specification is sparse.**"

URL: https://dam-cdn.nvd.orangelogic.com/AssetLink/v5rf2icnf86o26e464tf6djn23r8ibhe.pdf（`src.nvidia-vera-rubin-datasheet`，已在源登记表内）

产品页脚注 1 确实**没有**这句（我用 firecrawl 抓原文核对：产品页只有 "Preliminary information. All values are up to and subject to change."），所以应用基于产品页得出「未标注」没错；但同一项目已登记的数据手册把它讲死了。

**结论**：应用「不让它进 mathSpecs」的处置 **完全正确且现在有了硬证据**；只是 note 的措辞低估了确定性。
**建议修正**：note 改为「官方数据手册脚注 1 明确：『NVFP4 Inference specification is sparse.』——含稀疏，禁止进产能数学」，sourceId 保留 VR_PAGE 但 note 内引数据手册（或改挂 VR_DATASHEET）。同步更新 `cmp.rubin.rubin-gpu.mathSpecs.derivation` 里「没有稠密标注，故意不采用」的措辞。
